1320: Hay hod, kad itnehar binhiru dedikna illaa, (nusach acher da) veitpashshat bishar tikkunin nehirin. hay hu nose avon mehay gisa, veover al pesha mehay gisa. uvegin kach, (Shir HaShirim 5) lechayav ketiv. uvitzniuta desifra ikre, hod vehadar vetiferet. deha tiferet hu over al pesha, shenneemar (Mishlei 19:11) vetifarto avor al pesha. aval hay tiferet la okimna, ella betikkuna teshiaa, kema deat amer vetiferet bachurim kocham. vetamman ikre tiferet. vechad ittekal (sefer acher istakkal), bematkela chad sallekin. amar rabbi shimon, yeot ant ribbi abba, leitbarcha meattika kaddisha, dechol birchan nafkin minneh.

Tikkuna chamishaa. pasik saara, veitchazun teren tappuchin mikkan umikkan, sumakan kehay varda sumaka. umitlahatan bematan veshivin almin, hane tere tappuchin, kad neharin (muttarin sitrin) minnehiru ditren tappuchin kaddishin illain deattika, itmeshach sumaka, veate chivvara. behay ketiv, (Bamidbar 6:25) yaer Adonai panav elecha vichunnecha. dechad neharin mitberach alma. uveshaata deitavidu sumaka, ketiv yissa Adonai panav elecha, kelomar yistalak. vela yishtekach rugeza bealma. tana, kullehon nehorin deitnaharan meattika kaddisha, itkerun chasde kadmae. uvegin innun, naharin kol innun chasde olam.

Tikkuna shetitaa. nafik saara, kechad chuta desaare besacharaneh dedikna. (sefer acher vetalyayn ad resha dameavey velo nachit ad tabevarea, tanna tikkuna da hu deikre) peat hazzakan veihu chad mechamesh pein, detalyayn bechesed (uverachame), vela ive lechabbela hay chesed, kema deittemar. uvegin kach, (Vayikra 19:27) lo tashchit et peat zekanecha ketiv.

Tikkuna sheviaa. dela talyayn saara al puma, ufuma itpene mikkol sitroy, veyatvin sarin betikkuna sechor sechor leh. kum ribbi yehuda. kam ribbi yehuda, patach veamar, (Daniel 4:14) bigzerat irin pitgama. kema elef ribbevan mitneshan (sefer acher mateysheban) umitkayyeyman behay puma, vetalyayn minneh, vechulhon ikrun pe. hada hu dichtiv, (Tehillim 33:6) uveruach piv kol tzevaam. umehahu rucha denafik mippuma, mitlabbeshan.

Kol innun dilvar, talyayn mehay puma. umehay puma (sefer acher rucha) kad itpashat hay rucha, mitlabbeshan beh kama nevie mehemna, vechullehu pe Adonai itkerun. uvaatar derucha nafik, la itarva milla achara vechullehu (fiyyot) mechakkan leitlabbesha behahu rucha denafik. vehay tikkuna shallita al kullehu shita. mishshum dehacha mitkayyeyman kullehu umitachadan. uvegine kach sarohy shekilin socharaneh defuma. veitpene mikkol sitroy, vehay tikkuna shallita al kullehu mishshum dehacha mitkayyeyman kullehu umitachadan. amar rabbi shimon, berich ant leattika kaddisha.

Tikkuna teminaa denachtin sare bitchot dikna, mechappeyayn kedala dela itchaze. detanya, en lemala lo oref velo ifoy, uvezimna deaggach (sefer acher denatzach) kerave itchaze. mishshum leachazaa gevureta. deha tanenan, elef almin itachadayn minneh, hada hu dichtiv, (Shir HaShirim 4:4) elef hammagen taluy alav kol shilte haggibborim. veelef hammagen raza hu. bitzniuta desifra, kol shilte haggibborim deatu missetar gevura chad, meinnun gevuran.

Tikkuna teshiaa. deitmashshechan (sefer acher demitchabberan) sare beshikkula malya, im innun sare detalyayn, kullehu beshikkula shappir, kechad gibbar takkif, mare natzchan keravayyay. mishshum dechullehu sare itmashshechan batar innun detalyayn. uchelala dechullehu beinnun detalyayn. vecholla itmeshach, (chaser kan) veal da ketiv, (Mishlei 20:29) tiferet bachurim kocham. (venire al hayyam kabechaver tov hada hu dichtiv) ketiv (Shir HaShirim Adonai:15) bachur kaarazim, kegibbar avid gevuran, veda hu tiferet, chela ugevureta verachame.

Tana, amar rabbi shimon kol hane tikkunin, vechol hane millin, baena legallaa lemarehon deittekalu bematkela, vela leinnun dela alu (nusach acher dealu velo nafku) ella leillen dealu venafku, dechol maen deayil vela nafik, tav leh dela ivre.

Kelala dechol millin, attika deattikin, uzeer appin, kolla chad. kolla hava. kolla havi. kolla yehe. la yishtane. vela mishtane. vela shena. ittakkan betikunin illen. ishtelim diyyukena dechalil kol diukenin. diyyukena dechalil kol shemahan. diyyukena
1321: Deitchaze begoone kehay diyyukena (nusach acher begavvivy kol diukenin) lav hay diyyukena havi, ella keen hay diyyukena.

Kad itchabberan itrin vechitrin, keden hu ashlemuta decholla. begin, dediyyukena deadam, havi diyyukena deillain vetattain deitkelalu beh. uvegin dehay diyyukena kalil illain vetattain, atkin attika kaddisha tikkunoy, vetikkuna dizer appin, behay diyyukena vetikkuna.

Vei tema ma ben hay lehay. kolla hu bematkela chada, aval mikkan (nusach acher minnan) itparshan archoy. (nusach acher atepashetan rachame) umikkan (nusach acher vamenan) ishtechach dina. umissitra dilan havo shanyayn da min da. verazin illen la itmesaru, bar limchatztzede chakla kaddisha. uchetiv (Tehillim 25:14) sod Adonai lireav.

Ketiv (Bereshit 2:7) vayyitzer Adonai elohim et haadam, bitre yodin. ashlim tikkuna go tikkuna, tavreka degushepanka. veda hu vayyitzer. teren yodin lamma. raza deattika kaddisha, veraza dizer appin. vayyitzer, may tzar. tzar tzura bego tzura. (veda hu vayyitzer) umahu tzura bego tzura. teren shemahan, deitkere shem malle, Adonai elohim. veda hu raza ditren yodin devayyitzer, detzar tzura go tzura. tikkuna dishma shelim, Adonai elohim.
Uvema itkelilu. bediyyukena illaa da, deikre adam. dechalil dechar venukeba. veal da ketiv et haadam dechalil dechar venukeba. et: leappaka ulemisge zina denafik minneh. (midkar venukeba)

Afar min haadama: diyyukena bego diyyukena. vayyippach beappav nishmat chayyim: tavreka degushepanka go bego. vechol da lamma. begin leishtallefa uleayyeyla beh satim distima illaa, ad sofa dechol setimin. (hada hu dichtiv 0 vayyippach beappav nishmat chayyim) nishmeta, dechol chayye deella vetatta talyayn mehahi nishmeta, umitkayyme bah.

Vayhi haadam lenefesh chayya, leatterka, uleayyeyla betikunin kegavvna da, uleashlefa lehahi (nusach acher mehahi) nishmeta. middarga ledarga ad sofa dechol dargin. begin dihevi hahi nishmeta mishtakkecha becholla, umitpashsheta becholla. ulemehevi kolla beyichuda chad. uman defasik hay yichuda min alma, keman defasik nishmeta da, umechoze deit nishmeta achara, bar mehay. uvegin kach, yishtetze hu veducherane min alma ledare darin.

Behay diyyukena deadam, shari vetakin kelala dechar venukeba. kad ittakkan hay diyyukena betikkunoy, share mechaddoy, mibben teren deroin. beatar detalyayn sare dedikna, deitkerun (nusach acher deitkere) tiferet. veitpashshat hay tiferet, vetakin teren chaddin, veishtelayf laachoroy, veavad gulegalta denukeba. kolla setima mikkol sitroy. besara befartzufa deresha. uvichlala chada itavidu behay tiferet, veikre adam dechar venukeba. hada hu dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 44:13) ketiferet adam lashevet bayit.

Kad itbere partzufa deresha denukeba, talyay chad kotza desare meachoroy dizer appin, vetale ad resha denukeba. veittearu sare bereshaha, kullehu sumake dichlilan bego gevavne, hada hu dichtiv, (Shir HaShirim 7:6) vedallat roshech kaargaman. mahu argaman. gevavne dichlilan bego gevavne.
Tana, itpashat hay tiferet mitabbura delibba, venakiv veitavar begisa achara, vetakin partzufa denukeba ad tabbura. umitabbura share, uvetabbura shelim.

Tu itpeshat hay tiferet, veatkin meoy didchura, veayil (veittakkan) behay atar kol rachamin, vechol sitra derachame. vetana, behane meayyn itachadan, shit mea elef ribbo mare derachame. veitkerun baale meayyn. dichtiv, (Yirmeyahu 31:20) al ken hamu meay lo rachem arachamenu neum Adonai.
Tana, hay tiferet, kalil berachame, vechalil bedina, veitpashshat rachame bidchura, veitavar venakiv (sefer acher venahir) listar achara, vetakin meoy denukeba, veittekanu meaha besitra dedina.
Tana, ittakan dechura besitre, bematan utemanya vearbein tikkunin dichlilan beh, uminhon lego, uminnehon levar. minnehon rachame. uminnehon dina. kullehu
1322: Dedina, itachadu bedina daachoroy, denukeba itpashshatat tamman. veitachadu veitpashatu besitraha.

Vetana, chamisha eryayta (nusach acher tikkunin) itgalleyayn ba, besitra dedinin chamishsha. vedinin Adonai (nusach acher besitra dedina vadeynehaa) itpashshetan, bematan vearbein utemanya archin. vehachi tana, kol beishsha erva. sear beishsha erva. shok beishsha erva. yad beishsha erva. regel beishsha erva. deaf al gav ditren illen la shanyuha chavrana, uteren illen yattir meerva innun.

Vetana bitzniuta desifra, itpashat dechura veittakkan betikkunoy. ittakkan tikkuna dichsuta dachya. vehaay haveya amma dachya. archeh dehahu amma, matan vearbein utemanya almin. vechullehu talyayn befuma deamma, deitkere yod. vechevan deitgalyay yod pumeh deamma, itgele chesed illaa. vehay amma chesed hu deitkere, vetale (nusach acher vehay chesed hu tale) behay pum amma. vela ikre chesed, ad deitgalyay yod defum amma.

Veta chaze, dela itkere avraham shelim behay chesed, ad deitgalyay yod deamma. vechevan deitgele ikre shelim, hada hu dichtiv, (Bereshit 17:1) hithallech lefanay vehye tamim, tamim mammash. uchetiv (Shmuel 2 22:24) vaehye tamim lo vaeshtammera meavoni. may ka mayyre, resha vesefa. ella kol degalle hay yod, veistemar dela ayyleh leyod birshuta achara. lihevi shelim lealma deate, velehevi tzarir bitzrora dechayye. may birshuta achara. dichtiv, (Malachi 2:11) uvaal bat el nechar. uvegin kach ketiv, vaehye tamim lo, dechevan dehu tamim begilluyay deyod, vaeshtammera meavoni.

Vechevan deitpeshat amma da, itpeshat setar gevura meinnun gevuran (bismala) denukeba, veishteka benukeba baatar chad, vearshim beeryayta, kesutah dechol gufa denukeba. uvehahu atar ikre erva dechola. atar leatznea lehahu amma, deikre chesed. begin leitbassema gevura da dechalil chamesh gevuran, behay chesed dechalil bechamesh chasadin. chesed yemina, gevura semala. itbesam da beda, veikre adam, kalil mitteren sitrin. uvegin kach, bechullehu kitrin it yemina usemala, dina verachame.

Tana, ad la zammin tikkunoy demalka, attika deattikin, bana almin, veatkin tikkunin leitkayyeyma. hahu nukeba la itbasma, vela itkeyaymu, ad denachit (289 amud bet) chesed illaa veitkeyaymu, veitbesamu tikkune nukeba, behay amma deikre chesed. hada hu dichtiv, (Bereshit 36:31) veelle hammelachim asher malchu beeretz edom, atar dechol dinin mishtakkechin tamman (veinnun tikkune itteta, asher hayu lo ketiv ella asher malchu) vela itbesamu, ad deatkan kolla, venafik hay chesed, veityeshav befuma deamma. hada hu dichtiv, vayyamat vayyamat, dela itkeyaymu, vela itbesamu, dina bedina.

Vei tema i hachi dedina kullehu, veha ketiv vayyimloch tachtav shaul merchovot hannahar, veha la itchaze dina. detanenan, rechovot hannahar ihu bina, deminah mitpattechin chamshin tarin dinhorin uvutzinin, leshit sitre alma. tana, kullehu dina, bar mechad deitkayyaym batraa, vehay shaul merchovot hannahar, da hu chad sitra, deitpashat venafik merchovot hannahar.

Vechullehu la itkayaymu, la tema deitbatalu, ella dela itkayaymu behahu malchu, (uvistar nukeba) ad deittear veitpashshat hay batraa mekullehu, dichtiv vayyimloch tachtav hadar. may hadar. chesed illaa. veshem iro pau, may pau. behay pai bar nash dezache lerucha dekudesha veshem ishto mehetavel, bechan itbesamu da beda, veitkere ishto, ma dela ketiv bechullehu.
Mehetavel, itbasmuta deda beda. bat matred, tikkunin demissetar gevura. bat me zahav, itbesamu veitkelilu da beda, me zahav: rachame vedina. kan itdabbeku itteta bidchura.
Besitroy, itparshan bidroin, bashokin. deroin didchura, chad yemina, chad semala deroa kadmaa (sefer acher kaddisha)
1323: Telat kishrin itkashsharu beh, veitkelilu 2 deroin. veitkelilu salleka datach. ella 3 kishrin bimina, veg kishrin bismala. 3 kishrin dimina, itkelilan beg kishrin dismala. uvegin kach, deroa la ketiv ella chad. aval yemina, la ketiv beh zeroa, ella (Shemot 15:6) yemincha Adonai. (Tehillim 118:15) yemin Adonai itkere, beg kishrin daavahata deachasinu lechulakehon.

Vei tema ha bitlat chalalin mocha degulegalta mishtakkechin. tana, kullehu 3 mitpashshetin, umitkashsheran bechol gufa, vechol gufa itkeshar behane telat, umitkashsheran bidroa yemina. uvegin kach taiv david veamar, (Tehillim 110:1) shev limini. mishshum dehu itchabbar immehon daavahata, veyativ tamman lechuresya shelemata. uvegin kach ketiv (Tehillim 118:22) even maasu habbonim vegomer, mishshum deyativ limina. hayeynu dichtiv, (Daniel 12:13) vetanuach vetaamod legoralcha leketz hayyamin, kelomar, keman dezache lachavivuta demalka. zakkaa chulakeh, deman defaris malka yemineh. vekabbil leh techot yemineh. vehay yemina kad yetiv, kishrin itpashsheta.

Uderoa la oshit yedeh (sefer acher vakeshareyn lo atepashetav uderoa lo oshit yativ) bitlat keshirin deamaran. vechad mitarin chayyayvayya, umitpashshetan bealma, mitarin telat acharanin, deinnun dina kashya, veoshit deroa vechad oshit deroa, yad yemina hu, aval itkere (Yeshayahu 51:9) zeroa Adonai, (Devarim 9:29) zeroacha hanetuya (nusach acher telat kishrin itkeshsharu beh veitkalylu telat kishrin dimina utelat kishrin dismala 5 kishrin daavahata deachasinu lechulakehon. vei tema ha 5 challe mocha dagevalegaletaa mishtakkechin. tana kullehu 3 mitpashshetin umitkashsherin bechol gufa vechol gufa itkeshar behane telata umitkashsherin bidroa yemina. vehay yemina kad yativ 3 bitlat kishrin deamaran. vechad chayyayvayya mitarin. mitarin telat acharanin deinnun dina kashya veoshit deroa vaatakeray zeroa Adonai zeroecha hannetuya) bezimna deg ilen itkelilan 5 acharanin, ikre kolla yemina, veavid dina berachame, hada hu dichtiv, yemincha Adonai nedari bakkoach yemincha Adonai tiratz oyev, begin demitarin rachame behu.

Vetana, behay yemina mitachadan telat mea veshivin elef ribbo, deikrun yemina. umea vetimnin vachamishsha elef ribbo, mizzeroa deikre zeroa Adonai. mehay umehay talyay zeroa, vehay vehay ikre tiferet, dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 63:12) molich limin moshe, ha yemina. zeroa, ha semala. dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 63:12) zeroa tifarto, da beda.

Vetana, bida semala, mitachadan arba mea vechamshin ribbo mare terisin, mitachadan bechol etzbea veetzbea. uvechol etzbea veetzbea eser alfin mare terisin mishtakkechin. puk vachashov, kama innun devida. vehahu yemina ikre siyyua kaddisha, deati midderoa dimina, mittelat kishrin. (veaf al gav deikre yad have siyyua) dichtiv (uchetiv) (Shmuel 2 3:12) vehinne yadi immach. umitachadan mehay, elef vearba ribbo, utemanya, vechamesh mea alfin marehon desiyyuin bechol alma. veikrun yad Adonai illaa. yad Adonai tattaa. veaf al gav divchol atar yad Adonai semala. zachu yemin Adonai, itkelil yeda bizroa, vahavi siyyua, veikre yamin. vei lav, yad Adonai tattaa. tana, kad mitarin dinin kashyayn leachata bealma, hacha ketiv, (Tehillim 25:14) sod Adonai lireav.

Vetana bitzniuta desifra, dechol dinin demishtachchin middechura, takkifin beresha, venayychin besofa. vechol dinin demishtachchin minnukeba, nayychin beresha, vetakkifin besofa. veilmale deitavedu kachada, la yachlin alma lemisbal. ad deattik deattike setima decholla, parish da min da, vechavar lon leitbassema kachada.

Vechad parish lon, appil duremita lizer appin, ufaris lenukeba meachoroy desitroy, veatkin lah kol tikkunaha, veatznea leyoma dileh, lemetaha lidchura. hada hu dichtiv, (Bereshit 2:21) vayyappel Adonai elohim tardema al haadam vayyishan. mahu vayyishan. hay hu dichtiv, (Tehillim 44:24) ura lamma tishan Adonai. vayyikkach achat mitztzalotav, may achat. da hi nukeba. kema deat amer, (Shir HaShirim 6:9) achat hi yonati tammati, vesalleka, veittakna. uveatraha shekia rachame vechesed, hada hu dichtiv, (Bereshit 2:21) vayisgor basar tachtenna. uchetiv (Yechezkel 36:26) vahasiroti et lev haeven mibbesarchem venatatti lachem lev basar.

Uveshaata devaa lemeal shabbeta hava bare ruchin veshedin veilulin, vead la siyyem lon, atat matronita betikkunaha, veyativat kammeh. beshaata deyativat kammeh, anach lon leinnun biryayn, vela ishtelimu. kevan dematronita yatvat im malka,
1324: Veitchabbaru appin beappin, man yeul benayyhu, man hu deyikrav bahadayyhu. (begin kach setima demilla onatan shel talmide chachamim deyadin raza dena mishshabbat lashshabbat.) vechad itchabberu, itbesamu da beda. yoma decholla itbesam beh. uvegin kach, itbesamu dinin da beda, veittekanu illain vetattain.

Vetana bitzniuta desifra, baa attika kaddisha lemecheze, i itbesamu dinin, veitdevaku teren illen da beda, venafak missitra denukeba dina takkifa, (dela yachil alma lemisbal) dichtiv, (Bereshit 4:1) vehaadam yada et chavva ishto vattahar vatteled et kayin vattomer kaniti vegomer. vela hava yachil alma lemisbal, mishshum dela itbassemat, vechivya takkifa attil ba zuhama dedina kashya, uvegin kach la hava yachil leitbassema. vechad nafik da kayin missetar denukeba, nafak takkif kashya, takkif bedinoy, kashya bedinoy. kevan denafak itchalashat veitbassemat. batar da, appikat achara besima yattir, vesalik kadmaa dehava takkifa kashya, vechol dinin la itarvu (sefer acher ateareav) kameh (sefer acher vechol dinin 3 ittearu) immeh.

Ta chaze, ma ketiv, (Bereshit 4:8) vayhi bihyotam bassade. bassade: deishtemoda leella. bassade deikre sade detappuchim. venatzach hay dina laachu, mishshum dehava kashya minneh, veachpeyeh veatmereh techoteh. ad deittear behay kudesha berich hu, veabereh mikkammeh. veshakeh benukeba dithoma rabba. vechalil laachuy beshikkua deyamma rabba, dimvassem dimin illain. uminnehon nachtin nishmatin lealma, eynash lefum orchoy.

Veaf al gav ditmirin innun. mitpashshetin da beda, veitavidu gufa chad umehay gufa, nachtin nishmathon derashiayyay chayyayvayya, takife rucha. mittarvivyhon kachada salleka datach. ella da lesitroy, veda lesitroy. zakkain innun tzaddikayyay, dimshalfe nishmathon mehay gufa kaddisha deikre adam, dechalil kolla, atar deitrin vechitrin kaddishin mitchabberan tamman, bitzrora deatkela (sefer acher deatkala).

Zakkain innun tzaddikayyay, (sefer acher attun chavrayyay) dechol hane millin kaddishin, deitmaru beruach kaddisha illaa, ruach dechol kaddishin illain itkallelan beh, itgalyayn lechu. millin deillain vetattain tzayytin lehu, zakkain attun marehon demarin, mechatzde chakla, demillin illen tindeun vetistakkelun behu, vetindeun lemarechon appin beappin, ena beena. uvehane millin tizkun lealma deate, hada hu dichtiv, (Devarim 4:39) veyadata hayyom vahashevota el levavecha vegomer. Adonai: attik yomin hu haelohim. vecholla hu chad, berich shemeh lealam ulealme almayya.
Amar rabbi shimon, chamena illain letatta, vetattain leella. illain letatta, diyyukena deadam, dehu tikkune illaa, kelala dechullehu. (chaser)
Tana, ketiv (Mishlei 10:25) vetzaddik yesod olam, dechalil shit bekartufa kachada. vehay hu dichtiv, (Shir HaShirim Adonai:15) shokav ammude shesh.

Vetana bitzniuta desifra, baadam itkelilu kitrin illain, bichlal uvifrat. uveadam itkelilu kitrin tattain, bifrat uchelal. kitrin illain bichlal, kema deittemar bediyyukena dechol hane tikkunin (sefer acher diukenin). bifrat: beetzbean diydin, chamesh keneged chamesh. kitrin tattain, beetzbein deraglin deinnun perat uchelal. deha gufa la itchaze bahadayyhu. deinnun levar miggufa. uvegin kach la havo begufa. degufa adiu minnayyhu.

I hachi, may (Zecharya 14:4) veamdu raglav bayom hahu. ella raglav degufa, marehon dedinin (sefer acher dameareyn) lemebad nukemin veikrun baale raglayim. uminnehon takkifin. umitachadan marehon dedinin di letatta, bechitrin tattain.

Tana, kol innun tikkune dilella, divgufa kaddisha, (badekar venukeba) kelala deadam, itmeshich da min da, umitachadan da beda, veashkun da leda. kema deitmeshach dama bekitfin devaridin leda uleda, lehacha ulehacha, meatar da leatar achara, veinnun mashkin (sefer acher kasetayn) degufa (nusach acher legufa). ashkeyayn da leda, menaharin da leda. ad deanhiru kullehu almin, umitbarchan beginehon.
1325: Dela itkelilu begufa, kullehu rechikin umesaavin, umesaavan kol man deyikrav legabbehon, leminda minnehon millin.

Tana, may tiuveta dilhon legabbe talmide chachamim. ella mishshum dechaman behu gufa kaddisha, uleitkalla behu behahu gufa. vechi tema, i hachi, ha malachin kaddishin velethon bichlala degufa. la. dechas veshalom i lehevon levar mikkelala degufa kaddisha, la havo kaddishin vela mitkayyme. uchetiv (Daniel 10:6) ugeviyyayto chetarshish. uchetiv (Yechezkel 1:18) vegabbotam meleot enayim. (Daniel 9:21) vehaish gavriel. kullehu bichlala deadam. bar mehane delethon bichlala degufa, deinnun misavin, umesaavan kol man deyikrav bahadayyhu.

Vetana, kullehu merucha dismala, dela itbesam beadam mishtakkechin, venafku mikkelala degufa kaddisha, vela itdavaku beh. uvegin kach kullehu misavin veazlin vetasin alma, veayylin benukeba dithoma rabba, leitdabbeka behahu dina kadmaa deikre kayin, denafik bichlal degufa diltatta. veshatin vetasin kol alma, ufarchan vela mitdabbekan bichlala degufa, uvegine kach innun levar, mikkol mashiryayn dilella vetatta. misavin innun. behu ketiv (Vayikra 13:46) michutz lammachane moshavo.

Uverucha deikre hevel, deitbassam yattir bichlala degufa kaddisha. nafkin acharanin demibbasman yattir, umitdabbekan begufa, vela mitdabbekan. kullehu talyayn (76 amud bet) baavira venafkin mehay kelala deillen misavin. veshamin ma deshamin meella, uminnayyhu yade letatta dekaamre lehu.

Vetana bitzniuta desifra, kevan deitbesamu leella kelala deadam, gufa kaddisha, dechar venukeba. itchabbaru zimna telitaa, venafak itbassemuta decholla. veitbesamu almin illain vetattain. umikkan ishtachlal alma dilella vetatta, missitra degufa kaddisha. umitchabberan almin, umitachadan da beda, veitavidu chad gufa. (uvegin dechullehu chad gufa, shechinta leella, shechinta letatta, kudesha berich hu leella, kudesha berich hu 831) umeshallefa rucha, veayyla bechad gufa. uvechullehu la itchaze ella chad. (Yeshayahu 6:3) kadosh kadosh kadosh Adonai tzevaot melo kol haaretz kevodo. decholla hu chad gufa.

Tana, kevan deitbesamu da beda, (ketiv 0 tore zahav naase lecha im nekudot hakkesef) itkashsharu dina verachame. (atebasemaa dina berachame) veitbassemat nukeba bidchura. uvegine kach la salleka da belo da, kehay tamar, dela salleka da belo da. veal hay tanenan, man deappik garmeh behay alma mikkelala deadam, levatar kad nafik mehay alma, la ayel bichlala deadam, deikre gufa kaddisha. ella beinnun dela ikrun adam, venafik mikkelala degufa.

Tanya, tore zahav naase lach im nekudot hakkasef, deitbesamu dina berachame. velet dina, dela havo beh rachame. veal hay ketiv, (Shir HaShirim 1:10) navu lechayayich battorim tzavvarech bacharuzim. battorim: kemo dichtiv, tore zahav naase lach vegomer. bacharuzim: kema dichtiv, im nekudot hakkasef. tzavvarech, bichlala denukeba, da matronita ishtechach be makdesha dilella, viyrushalam diltatta (sefer acher umikdesha decholla) umakdesha. vechol da miditbesamat bidchura, veitavid kelala deadam, veda hu kelala dimhemnuta. may mehemnuta. divgavvih ishtechach kol mehemnuta.

(Shayych parashat ki tetze) vetana, man deikre adam, venishmeta nafkat minneh, umit. asir lemevat leh beveta, lemebad leh lina al ara, mishshum yekara dehay gufa, dela yitchaze beh kelana, dichtiv, (Tehillim 49:13) adam bikar bal yalin, adam dehu yakar mikkol yekara, bal yalin. may tama. mishshum dei yaavdun hachi, nimshal kabbehemot nidmu. ma beire la havo bichlala deadam, vela itchaze behu rucha kaddisha, uf hacha kivire, gufa bela rucha, vehay gufa, dehu yekara decholla, la yitchaze beh kelana.
Vetana bitzniuta desifra, kol man deavid lina lehay gufa kaddisha, bela rucha, avid pegimuta begufa dealmin. deha begin
1326: Da, la avid lina beatra kaddisha, beara detzedek yalin bah, (sefer acher dechitra kaddisha demalka beara dichtiv 0 tzedek yalin bah) mishshum dehay gufa yekara, itkere diyyukena demalka. vei avid beh lina, havi kechad min beire. (hada hu dichtiv, 1 nimshal kabbehemot 2 nidmu)

Tana, (Bereshit 6:2) vayyiru vene haelohim et benot haadam. (sefer acher bene haelohim) innun (60 amud bet) deitmaru, venaflu benukeba dithoma rabba. et benot haadam, (haadam hayyadua). uchetiv veyaldu lahem hemma haggibborim asher meolam vegomer. mehahu deikre olam. kidtanenan yeme olam. anshe hashshem, minnehon nafku ruchin veshedin lealma, leitdabbeka berashiayay.
Hannefilim hayu vaaretz, leappaka illen acharanin. dela havo baaretz. hannefilim: azza veazzael havo baaretz. bene haelohim la havo baaretz. veraza hu vecholla ittemar.

Ketiv (Bereshit 6:6) vayyinnachem Adonai ki asa et haadam baaretz, leappaka adam dilella, dela havi baaretz. vayyinachem Adonai hay bizer appin ittemar. vayyitatztzev el libbo, vayyetzav lo neemar. ella vayyitatztzev, ihu itatztzav, deveh talyay milleta. laappuke mimman dela itatztzav. el libbo, belibbo la ketiv, ella el libbo. keman deitatztzav (umekabbel) lemareh, deachze hay lelibba dechol libbin.
Vayyomer Adonai emche et haadam asher barati meal pene haadama vegomer. leappaka adam dilella. vei tema adam diltatta bilchodoy. lav leappaka kelal. mishshum dela kaim da bela da.
Veilmale chachma setima decholla, kolla ittakkan kemeresha. hada hu dichtiv, (Mishlei 8:12) ani chachma shachanti arma. al tikre shachanti, ella shechinatti (sefer acher shaykanetay).
Veilmale hay tikkuna deadam, la kaim alma. hada hu dichtiv, (Mishlei 3:19) Adonai bechachma yasad aretz. uchetiv (Bereshit 6:8) venach matza chen beene Adonai.

Vetana, kullehu mochin talyayn behay mocha. vehachachma hu kelala decholla hu. veda chachma setima, devah ittakif veittakkan tikkuna deadam, leityayshsheva kolla al tikkuneh, kol chad beatreh. hada hu dichtiv, (Kohelet 7:19) hachachma taoz lechacham measara shallitim, deinnun tikkuna shelema deadam. veadam hu tikkuna dilgo, minneh kaim rucha. (hada hu dichtiv, 1 ki haadam yire laenayim vayhva yire lallevav, deihu balegav lego)

Uvehay tikkuna deadam, itchaze shelemuta mehemnuta decholla, dekaim al kuresyyay. dichtiv, (Yechezkel 1:26-27) udemut kemare adam alav milmala. uchetiv (Daniel 7:13) vaaru im anane shemaya kevar enash ate hava vead attik yomayya meta ukedamohi hakervuhi. ad kan setiman millin. uveriran taamin. zakkaa chulakeh deman deyada veyashgach behon. vela yite behon. demillin illen la ityehivu, ella lemare medin umechatzde chakla, dealu venafku. dichtiv, (Hoshea 14:10) ki yesharim darche Adonai vetzaddikim yelchu vam ufoshim yikkashlu vam.

Tana, bacha rabbi shimon, vearim kaleh veamar, i bemillin dilan, deitgalleyayn hacha, itgenizu chavrayyay beiddara dealma deate, veistellaku mehay alma, yaut veshappir hava, begin dela itgalleyayn lechad mibbene alma. hadar veamar, haderi bi, deha galle kammeh deattika deattikin, setima dechol setimin, deha la likara dili avidna, vela likara devet abba, vela likara dechavrayyay illen, ella begin dela yitun beorchoy, vela yaalun bechissufa letare palteroy, vela yimmechun bidehon. zakkaa chulaki immehon, lealma deate.

Tana, ad la nafku chavrayay mehahu iddara, mitu (160 amud alef amud alef) ribbi yose baribbi yaakov, veribbi chizkiyya, veribbi yesa. vechamu chavrayyay, dahavo natlin lon malachin kaddishin behahu parsa. veamar rabbi shimon milla, veishtechachu. tzavavch veamar, shemma chas veshalom gezera itgezar alana leitannesha, deitgele al yedana ma dela itgele miyyoma dekaim moshe al tura desinay, dichtiv, (Shemot 34:28) vayhi sham im Adonai arbaim yom vearbaim layla vegomer. ma ana hacha. i begin da itanashu.
Shama kala, zakkaa ant rabbi shimon, zakkaa chulakach vechavrayyay, illen dekayymin bahadach, deha itgele lechon ma dela itgele lechol chela dilella,
1327: Aval ta chaze, deha ketiv, (Yehoshua 6:26) bivchoro yeyassedenna uvitziro yatztziv delateha. vekol shekken deviru saggi vetakkif, itdavaku nafshathon beshaata da deitnesivu. zakkaa chulakehon, deha bishlemuta istalaku. (dela hava ken leinun dahavo kammayyhu, amay mitu)

Tana, beod deitgalleyayn millin, itregisho illain vetattain, (deinnun retichin) vekala ittear bematan vechamshin almin deha millin attikin letatta itgalyayn, vead (nusach acher veod) deillen mitbasseman nishmatayyhu beinnun millin, nafka nishmatayyhu binshika, veitkashshar behahu parsa, venatlin lehu malache illae, vesallekin lon leella. vaamay illen. mishshum dealun vela nafku zimna achara min kadmat dena, vechullehu acharine alu venafku.

Amar rabbi shimon, kama zakkaa chulakehon dehane telata, vezakkaa chulakana lealma deate begin da. nafak kala tinyaynut veamar, (Devarim 4:4) veattem haddevekim baAdonai elohechem chayyim kulchem hayyom. kamu veazlu. bechol atar dahavo mistakkele salik rechin. amar rabbi shimon shema minnah, dealma mitberach beginan. vahavu naharin anpoy dechullehu, vela havo yachlin bene alma leistakkela behu.

Tana, asara alu, vesheva nafku, vahava chadde rabbi shimon. veribbi abba atziv. yoma chad hava yativ rabbi shimon veribbi abba immeh, amar rabbi shimon milla, vechamu leillen telata dahavo mayytin lehon malachin illain, umechazyayn lehu genizin veiddarin dilella, begin yekara dilhon. vahavu ayyle lon beture deafarsemona dachya. nach dateh deribbi abba.

Tana, mehahu yoma la adu chavrayyay mibbe rabbi shimon. vechad hava rabbi shimon megalle razin, la mishtakkechin tamman ella innun. vahava kare lehu ribbi shimon, shiva anan ene Adonai. dichtiv, (Zecharya 4:10) shiva elle ene Adonai vealan ittemar. amar ribbi abba, anan shita botzine, denaharan mishsheviaa. ant hu sheviaa decholla. deha let kiuma leshita, bar mishsheviaa. decholla tale bishviaa. ribbi yehuda kare leh shabbat, dechullehu shita minneh mitbarchin, dichtiv, (Shemot 20:10) shabbat laAdonai, kodesh laAdonai, ma shabbat laAdonai kodesh, uf rabbi shimon shabbat laAdonai kodesh.

Amar rabbi shimon, tavvavhna al hahu chagir chartzan, mareh desare, amay la ishtechach beve iddara dilan, bezimna deitgalleyayn millin illen kaddishin. addehachi, ata eliyyahu, utelat katfore nehirin beanpoy. amar leh rabbi shimon, may tama la shechiach mor bekarduta (sefer acher bakeratemaa) gelifa demareh, beyoma dehillula.

Amar leh, chayyecha ribbi sheva yomin itberiru kammeh kudesha berich hu, kol innun deyetun veyishtachchun immeh, al la ayiltun beve iddara dilchon, uvaena leishtakkecha, zammin katir bechatfoy (sefer acher 80 shekken tzarich lomar, vaana hava zammin tamman, uvaena kammeh leishtakkecha, ucheden katir baketapevay) vela yachilna, dehahu yoma shadarni kudesha berich hu, lemebad nissin lerav hamenuna sava vechavroy, deitmesaru bearmona (sefer acher bakeravenaya) demalka, vearchishna lehu benissa, deramena lehu kotala dehechala demalka, veitketaru bekitroy, demitu arbaim vachamishsha pardashke. vaappikna lerav hamenuna vechavroy veramena (sefer acher vaavaleykenaa) lon levikat ono, veishtezivu. vezaminna kammayyhu nahama umayyay, dela achlu telata yomin. vechol hahu yoma la badilna minnayyhu.

Vechad tavna, ashkachna parsa denatlu kol innun samchin, utelat min chavrayyay alah, veshailna lon. veamru chulaka dekudesha berich hu, mehillula derabbi shimon vechavroy. zakkaa ant rabbi shimon, vezakkaa chulakach, vechulaka deinnun chavrayyay deyatvin kammach. kama dargin ittakanu lechon lealma deate. kama botzinin dinhorin zeminin lenahara lechu.

Veta chaze, yoma den beginach itattaru chamshin kitrin leribbi pinchas ben yair chamuch. vaana azilna immeh bechol innun nahare deture deafarsemona dachya, vehu barir ducheteh, veittakkan. (sefer acher vaana ha chazena deha barir vechulei) amar leh, keturin tzaddikayyay bekartufa deitrin,
1328: Veolif lon archoy, leitdabbeka beh, ulemetar pikkude deorayyta, lemizke behu lealma deate. vekariv lehu beshaata denafku mimmitzrayim, deha keden appik lon mershuta achara, vesalik lon leitachada bishmeh, ucheden ikrun bene yisrael, bene chorin mikkolla. dela yatvu techot reshuta achara, vesalik lon leachada bishmeh, desalik al kolla, deshallit al illain vetattain.

Umiggo rechimuta dilhon, kara lon (Shemot 4) beni vechori yisrael, kegavvna (dikdushsha) illaa (veal da). katal (sefer acher uketal) kol bechor dilella vetatta, veshara ketirin veassirin deillain vetattain, begin leappaka lon, veavid lon bene chorin mikkolla. veal da la baa kudesha berich hu, la malach, vela saraf, ella ihu. veod, deha ihu yada leavchana uleminda kolla, ulemishre asirin, velav innun birshuta dishlicha achara ella bideh.

Ta chaze, behahu lelya devaa kudesha berich hu lekatla kol innun bechore kema deittemar, beshaata deramash lelya, atu mezammerin lezammera kammeh, amar lon, lav iddan hu deha shirata achara, mezammerin banay beara. beshaata deitpelig lelya, ittear ruach tzafon, vekudesha berich hu keden avad nukemin, veyisrael avdin shirata bekol ram, (sefer acher veyisrael mezammerin veamrin haleylea bekol ram) ucheden avad lon bene chorin mikkolla, umalachin illae, vechol mashiryayn kullehu, havo tzayytin lehon lekalehon deyisrael. batar deitgezaru, reshimu levattehon, mehahu dama, umiddama defischa, bitlat reshimin. (Shemot 12:23) al hammashkof veal shete hammezuzot.

May tama. ha ukemuha begin deihu reshima kaddisha, umechabbela kad ihu nafik, vechame hahu dama dehava rashim al hahu pitcha, chayis alayyhu deyisrael, hada hu dichtiv ufasach Adonai al happetach vegomer. hacha it leistakkela, i kudesha berich hu ate vekatil beara demitzrayim, velo sheliach achara, reshima da deal pitcha lamma, veha kolla gale kammeh. vetu, mahu velo yitten hammashchit, velo yashchit mibbae leh.

Ella vadday hachi hu, dichtiv, (Shemot 12:29) vaAdonai hikka chol bechor. vaAdonai: hu uvet dino. vehahu be dina hacha ishtechach. (sefer acher mikkan divcholla) uvecholla bae leachazaa ovada, begin leishtezava. deha kegavvna da al gabbe madbecha, begin dela ishtechach mechabbela.

Hay beovada, uvezimna dela itzterich hay, kegon rosh hashshana, deihu yoma dedina, umarehon delishana bisha kayymin alayyhu deyisrael, baenan millin, tzelotin uvautin, uvaenan leachazaa ovada (sefer acher berucha venafsha) kema deokimna. veha ittemar, uvema. bashshofar. (leachazaa shofar) leatteara shofra achara. vaanan mefikin behahu kala, rachame vedina kachada, kolla kadka yaut. kema dehahu shofar illaa, appik kala deihu kelala kachada. uleatara rachame kaazlenan, uletabbera marehon dedina, dela yishletun behay yoma. vechad rachame mitarin, kullehu butzinin illain naharin mehay gisa umehay gisa. keden (Mishlei 16:15) beor pene melech chayyim.

Ta chaze, beshaata dechahana (Rava) itkevavn leadleka butzinin letatta, vahava kariv ketoret busemin, behahu shaata keden butzinin illain naharin, veitketar kolla kachada, vechidu vechedvavta ishtechach bechullehu almin, hada hu dichtiv, (Mishlei 27:9) shemen uketoret yesammach lev, veal da behaalotcha et hannerot.

Ribbi elazar veribbi yose veribbi yitzchak, havo azle beorcha, pagu beinnun ture kardo, ad dahavo azle, zakaf enoy ribbi elazar, vechame innun ture ramae, vahavu chashochan, vedachalan bidchilu. amar ribbi elazar leinnun chavrayyay, illu abba hacha, la hava dachilna, aval kevan daanan telata, umille deorayyta benana, dina hacha la ishtechach.

Patach ribbi elazar veamar, ketiv vattanach hatteva vachodesh hashshevii vegomer, al hare ararat vegomer, kema chavivin mile deorayyta, divchol mila umilla, it razin ilain, veorayyta kolla, illaa ikre. vetanenan bitlesar mechilan deorayyta, chol davar shehaya bichlal, veyatza min hakkelal, lelammed, lo lelammed al atzmo yatza, ella lelammed al hakkelal kullo yatza. deha orayyta deihi
1329: Kelala illaa, af al gav denafik minnah, chad sippur bealma. vday la ate leachazaa al hahu sippur, ella leachazaa millin illain, verazin illain. velo lelammed al atzmo yatza, ella lelammed al hakkelal kullo yatza. begin dehahu sippur deorayyta, o hahu ovada, af al gav dehu nafka michlala deorayyta, lav leachazaa al garmeh nafak bilvad, ella leachazaa al hahu kelala illaa deorayyta kolla nafak.

Kegon hay dichtiv, (Bereshit 8:4) vattanach hatteva bachodesh hashshevii beshiva asar yom lachodesh al hare ararat. vadday hay kera mikkelala deorayyta nafak, veate besippur dealma. may ichpat lan, i share behay, o behay, deha baatar chad lishre. ella lelammed al hakkelal kullo yatza. vezakkain innun yisrael, deityehiv lehu orayyta illaa orayyta dikshot. uman deamar, dehahu sippura deorayyta, leachazaa al hahu sippur bilvad kaate, tippach rucheh. dei hachi, lav ihi orayyta illaa, orayyta dikshot, ella vadday orayyta kaddisha illaa, ihi orayyta dikshot.

Ta chaze, melech basar vadam, lav yekara dileh hu, leishtae milla dehedyota, kol shekken lemichtav leh, vei salik bedatach, demalka illaa kudesha berich hu, la havo leh millin kaddishin, lemichtav ulemebad minnayyhu orayyta, ella deihu kanish kol millin dehedyotin, kegon millin deesav. millin dehagar. millin delavan beyaakov. millin deaton. millin devilam. millin devalak. millin dezimri. vechanish lehu, vechol shear sippurin dichtivin, veavid minnayyhu orayyta.

I hachi, amay ikre (Malachi 2:6) torat emet, (Tehillim 19:8-9) torat Adonai temima, edut Adonai neemana, pikkude Adonai yesharim, mitzvat Adonai bara, yirat Adonai tehora, mishpete Adonai emet, uchetiv hannechemadim mizzahav umippaz rav. illen innun mille deorayyta. ella vday orayyta kaddisha illaa, ihu orayyta dikshot, torat Adonai temima. vechol milla umilla, atyay leachazaa millin (acharanin) illain, dehahu milla dehahu sippur, lav leachazaa al garmeh bilvad ka aty, ella leachazaa al hahu kelala kaate, kema deokimna.

Ta chaze vattanach hatteva vegomer. hay kera kach, kol shekken acharanin, (sefer acher hay kera kach ihu veha ittemar) beshaata dedina tale al alma, vedinin sharyayn, vekudesha berich hu yativ al kuresyay dedina lemedan alma behahu kuresyay, kama reshimin itreshimu beh, kama pitkin genizin begavih, bego achmeta demalka, kullehu sefarim diftichu tamman itgenizu, uvegin kach la itneshe milla min malka, vehay kuresyay la atkan, vela sharya. ella bachodesh hashshevii, deihu yoma dedina, yoma dechol bene alma itpakkedun beh, kullehu avrin kamme hahu kurseyay. veal da, vattanach hatteva bachodesh hashshevii, bachodesh hashshevii vday, deihu dina dealma.

Al hare ararat, illen (samche kuresyay) marehon dedinin, marehon divava vilala, vechullehu shelichin (sefer acher dechullehu shakeykeyn) behahu yoma kamme kudesha berich hu vechamma mare terisin ittearu behay yoma, vechullehu kayyme techot hahu kurseyay, bedina dealma.

Veyisrael metzalan tzelota behahu yoma, uvaan umitchannenan kammeh, vetakin bashshofar, vekudesha berich hu chayis alayyhu, umehappech dina lerachame. vechol illae vetattae, patche veamre, (Tehillim 89:16) ashre haam yode terua. veal da baena behahu yoma, dehahu detaka, deyada ikkara demilla, vichavvivn beh bitrua, veyabid milla bechachmeta, veal da ketiv, ashre haam yode terua, vela ketiv toke terua, veha ittemar.

Azlu kol hahu yoma, kad ramash lelya, seliku lechad atar, veashkachu chad mearta. amar ribbi elazar, liul chad go mearta, i ishtechach atar deihu yattir metatkkan. al ribbi yose, vechama mearta achara begavvih, nehora dishraga beh, shama chad kala dehava amar, behaalotcha et hannerot el mul pene hammenora yairu shivat hannerot. hacha natla keneset yisrael nehora, veima illaa
1330: Mitattera, vechullehu butzinin minah naharin. bah teren tufesirin dekikin parchin, shushevinin (sefer acher shabeshabeyn) kullehu kotrin legabbe illaa, umittamman letatta.

Shama ribbi yose vechadde, ata legabbe ribbi elazar, amar leh ribbi elazar, neul, dekudesha berich hu akdim lan hay yoma, leitrachasha lan benissin. alu, kevan dealu, chamu teren bene nasha, dahavo laan beorayyta. amar ribbi elazar, (Tehillim 36:8) ma yakar chasdecha elohim uvene adam betzel kenafecha yechesayun. kamu illen, veyatve kullehu, vechaddu kullehu, amar rivi elazar, ma yakar chasdecha elohim, deashkachna lechu. chesed avad lan kudesha berich hu baatar da, hasheta adliku butzinin.

Patach ribbi yose veamar. (Bamidbar 8:2) behaalotcha et hannerot, behaalotcha mammash, beadlakutach. deha kachada itavid al yeda dechahana teren pulechanin. deinnun kishshura chada. uman innun. shemen uketoret. kedichtiv, (Mishlei 27:9) shemen uketoret yesammach lev. dichtiv, (Shemot 30:8) vehiktir alav aharon vegomer. uchetiv uvehaalot aharon et hannerot ben haarbayim yaktirenna. may shena hacha behetivo, umay shena hatam uvehaalot. amar ribbi yehuda, kolla chad milla.

Ribbi yose amar, behetivo: kema deat amer (Shir HaShirim 1:2) ki tovim dodecha miyyayin. tovim: ravivy chamra. kema deat amer, (Yirmeyahu 44:17) vannisba lechem vannihye tovim. ribbi yehuda amar, hatava mammash. kema deat amer (Mishlei 15:15) vetov lev mishte tamid. uvehaalot, deha bezimna deitteshakyayn veitravyayn mishshakyu denachala, keden illain illuya, uvirchan (sefer acher illain matetaayn) ishtakkechu bechullehu, vechaddu becholla. veal da uvehaalot.

Ribbi acha amar, beshaata daamika decholla nahir, (sefer acher dasetaymaa decholla nahir) nahir benachala. venachala, nagid (sefer acher nahir) beorach meshar leashkaa kolla. keden ketiv, behaalot (nusach acher behetivo) begin deha meumeka decholla nafke, behaalot deate missitra illaa, (Bereshit 21 1) deamika (sefer acher dasetaymaa) decholla, deikre machashava. vecholla chad milla, ucheden cheneset yisrael itbarcha, uvirkan ishtakkeche bechullehu almin.

Ribbi yitzchak patach, ketiv (Melachim 1 8:13) bano baniti bet zevul lach machon leshivtecha olamim. bet zevul, bet zevul vadday, kad itpekadu bidaha, kol ginze malka, veshalta behu. keden ikre bet zevul. verakia chad it deikre zevul, deha da ashkach lekabbela birchaan, ulesaddera kolla, vehay ikre bet zevul.

Ta chaze, ketiv (Devarim 33:18) velizvulun amar semach zevulun betzetecha veyissasochar beoholecha, melammed deishtatafu kachada. da nafik veagach kerava, veda yativ velae beorayyta. veda yahiv chulaka leda, veda yahiv chulaka leda. bechulakeh dizvulun yamma, ukkeneset yisrael ikre yam kinneret. vehachi itchaze, begin deha techelet nafik mittamman, veokmuha, deha letatta kegavvna dilella, yam kinneret leella, yam kinneret letatta. techelet leella, techelet letatta, vecholla baatar chad.

Veal da yarit zevulun, lemeppak leaggacha kerava, umenalan dehachi hu. dichtiv, (Devarim 33:19) ammim har yikrau sham yizbechu zivche tzedek. zivche tzedek vadday. may tama. ki shefa yammim yinaku. veyissasochar chulakeh beorayyta, veyahiv lizvulun chulaka deorayta vadday, veal da ishtattafu kachada, leitbarcha zevulun miyissesochar, devirchata deorayyta, hi birchata decholla.

Ribbi abba amar, achasanta deorayyta vday hachi hu, vedarga da shetitaa yahiv agar (sefer acher chad shetitaa yahiv agar) orayyta, veachasin lah likkeneset yisrael, achasin chivvavra litchelta. veal da tanenan, mishsheyyakkir ben techelet lelavan, deyishtemodaon gevavne, deha keden ikre boker, vechivvavra ate lealma, utechelta itavar. veal da kol keravin demalka, vechol zayyne malka bidaha itmanan, veha okimna. (chaser techillat hammaamar veayyen parashat vayyelech 286 amud alef)

(Bamidbar 21:18) beer chafaruha sarim karuha nedive haam, beer, da keneset yisrael. chafaruha sarim, da abba veima, deolidu lah. karuha nedive haam, illen avahan. dichtiv, (Tehillim 47:10) nedive ammim neesafu am elohe avraham vegomer. begin
1331: Leitbarcha minnehon, al yede dedarga chad, umanno. tzaddik dekaim ala. veal da amrenan, kad hay beer natla, besiua daavahan natla.

Veikre beer, veikkere yam. ikre beer, beshaata deyitzchak nafik mizzayyna missitra deima, veate leamshacha abbatra deda, umalle lah, keden ikre beer deyitzchak. beer demiryam. veha ukemuha. yam kad itnahara minnahara illaa deabba, keden ikre yam, denachalin azlin legavvav, kema deat amer (Kohelet 1:7) kol hannechalim holchim el hayyam vehayyam enennu male.

Umiyyoma degalta keneset yisrael begaluta, ketiv (Iyov 14:11) azlu mayim minni yam, da cheneset yisrael. venahar yecherav veyavesh, da tzaddik. veal da ketiv, (Yeshayahu 57:1) hatztzadik avad vegomer. dehu hava nahar illaa veyakira, deayil begavav, vehu kanish kol innun naharin unachalin, denagdin minnegidu dehahu nahar kaddisha, dela paskin memoy lealmin, denagid venafik meeden illaa, vehu ayel begavvav umalle agmaha, umittamman yartin almin kullehu (ittezanu veyartin) birkan becholla.
Ta chaze, beshaata deitbarcha keneset yisrael, almin kullehu itbarchan, veyisrael letatta, yankin umitbarchan beginah. veha okimna dehi agana alayyhu, deyisrael, kema deittemar.

Ketiv (Shemot 14:19) vayyissa malach haelohim haholech vegomer. malach haelohim da keneset yisrael. veha okimna, dehahi shaata, besiua daavahan natla. vechad innun mishtakkechin legabbah, kolla mishtakkeche. uvegin kach itmesar beillen kerae shema kaddisha, dechalil behon avahata, kema deokimna. chad kera kesidra, vechad lemafrea, vechad kesidra.

Vayyissa malach haelohim haholech vegomer, da kesidra begin deavraham ishtechach hacha, vechol innun deatu missitreh, veal da ihu kesidra kegavvna da. (amar 63 kan matzati katuv pasuk vayyissa keseder kol ot veot bevet echad bameravebaa im ze hallashon vetimtzaem kullam besof 10 besof Shemot)

Hacha itattar avraham beitroy, veattar lah lichneset yisrael, veillen atvavn kullehu beorach meshar, lemehach bimama. dichtiv (Tehillim 42:9) yomam yetzavve Adonai chasdo uvallayla shiro immi. veal da ketiv vayyissa, ematay natlin bematlanayyhu, havi ema bimama, kad nahir shimsha. veda chad kera deihu beshivin uteren atvavn.

Tinyayna deyitzchak, hachi name deishtechach bev atvavn, leishtachcha bedina legabbe mitzrae ulegabbe yisrael berachame. veal da ketiv, vayyavo ben machane mitzrayim uven machane yisrael, lokovel illen velokovel illen. vayhi heanan vehachoshech, dehachi hu yoma deyitzchak, deiva havi, anana vachashocha minneh hu. uvegin kach sidura deatvavn lemafrea, (beorcha akima) vela beorach meshar, kegavvna da. (kan matzati katuv pasuk vayyavo lemafrea kol ot veot bevet echad bameravebaa im ze hallashon)

Veal da atvavn kullehu lemafrea, dichtiv vayhi heanan vehachoshech, dechevan deal yitzchak bedinoy, lo karav ze el ze. ketiv ze el ze, innun deatu missitra deavraham, la kerivu da beda. deha la yachlin, begin dehay beer itdabbeka beyitzchak. kema deat amer, vayyaer et hallayla. dechad itmalleyay leitchabbera (sefer acher leatkefa) beyitzchak, lo karav ze el ze, vela yachil lekarva. ad deata yaakov, veitchabbar beavraham, venatal leyitzchak, veshari leh beemtzaita, keden itkeshar mehemnuta da beda veda beda, veishtezivu yisrael.
Vetanenan, baatar daavahata ishtachche, shear tzadikayyay mishtachche gabbayyhu, veal da shema da, salik lesitrin acharanin mitparshan, af al gav dechullehu nafkin learcha chad.
Kad nahara hay beer missitra deyitzchak, veitkashar beh, itavid yamma rabba takkifa, vegalgelin takkifin, salleykin venachtin bezaaf verugeza bitkifu, natil leella,
1332: Salik, venachit letatta, avraham ate lekobbela (sefer acher lokovleh), umiggo rugeza vezapa vechemata utekifu, ze el ze la havo mitkarvin, ad deata yaakov, veshachich rugeza, umaich vetavar galgalle yamma, hada hu dichtiv, (Shemot 14:21) vayyet moshe et yado al hayyam vayyolech Adonai et hayyam beruach kadim azza vegomer. may beruach kadim azza. da ruach yaakov, azza takkif lokovleh, letavra rugeza dehay yamma. vayyasem et hayyam lecharava vayibbaku hammayim (nusach acher hu) arik yamma meme rugezin, veitfeligu mayya lesitra deavraham ulesitra deyaakov, hada hu dichtiv vayibbaku hammayim lesitra da ulesitra da. veal da atvavn kullehu beorach meshar kaddeka yeut. (kan haya katuv pasuk vayyet keseder kol ot veot bevet echad bameravebaa im ze hallashon)

Illen atvavn beorach meshar, bistar deyaakov, vechol innun deatu missitreh, vechad ata yaakov, itchabbar beavraham, venatal leyitzchak, veshari leh beemtzaita. keden itkeshar mehemnuta da beda veda beda. veal da, ovada betikkuna bishma kadisha beziuuga daavahan ishtemoda, deihu kishshura chad, kishshura mehemana, lemehevi reticha shelemata. uveziuuga daavahan kachada, itavid kolla.

Veyadin chavrayyay lemehach beorach meshar, leatkkena ovadin kaddeka yeut, uvishma da kishshura daavahan, ishtechachu orchin ledina, ulerachame, lesiyyyua, lechesed, lidchilu, leorayyta, lechayye, lemota, letav, levish. zakkain innun tzaddikayyay, deyadin orchoy deorayyta, veyadin lemehach beorchoy demalka kaddisha, zakkain innun bealma den uvealma deate. (vechan matzati 77 Shemot hayyotzim 43 pesukim ellu bameravebaa kol sham vesham 43 otiyyot bevet echad yashar hafuch yashar, vesimanich yehe or velo hadepasetay oto mippene yekar tiferet kadevashetav)

Ha avahan bematlanin, beovadin, bekishshurin demitkashshere da beda. vechad mitchabberan kachada, let man diykum kammayyhu. vetanenan, baatar daavahata ishtekachu, shear tzadikayyay mishtakkeche gabbayyhu. veal da shema da salik lesitrin acharanin mitparshan, af al gav dechullehu nafkin learcha chad.
Shiva kishshurin innun, demitkashshere behu 3 avahan, ved acharanin. resha veemtzaita bekishshura chada. veillen innun dechafru bera demaya. tinyayna ze el ze, veinnun kishshura chada, bitlat yodin.

Telitaa, shelimu dechol mehemnuta. reviaa, teren kayyaymin, degufa kayyayma alayyhu. chamishaa, tav uvish, nahara denafik ilana dechayye umota, (Bereshit 221 amud alef) amikta decholla. shetitaa, dina berachame. sheviaa, bekadmita ittemar, behahu resha deamaran, begin deihu emtzaita decholla. uvegin deihu emtzaita decholla, ikre (Shemot 55 amud alef) ani, kiyyuma dechol anfin demitachadan missacharaneh.

Shiva dargin illen, midarga chada ledarga chada (sefer acher achara), ishtemoda reticha chada, bechol innun demitachadan beh. vechen midarga ledarga, vechullehu itnahagan abbatreh dehahu darga deitpakkeda alayyhu, veha okimna mille.

Ta chaze, beshaata deillen dargin mishtachche, kol mehemnuta ishtechach, veillen shiva ananin deascharu lehu leyisrael. begin kach kad natla shechinta, baavahata natla. vechad illen natlin, kullehu dargin acharanin natlin behu, ucheden itatterat keneset yisrael kaddeka yaut.
Ta chaze, zevulun dekaamran yarit yam kinneret. yam kinneret setam, vehachi itchaze. i hachi yehuda ma chulaka it beh, ella yehuda natal malchuta kolla, veitachid beh bechol sitrin.

Ribbi elazar amar, hay parsheta, ha ittemar ovada dimnarta vetikunaha vechol ma devah, amay hachi zimna achara. ella kevan dinsiim kerivu (leella) kurebna demadbecha, vechol tikkuna deitchaze leh, ata kera veishtae ovada dimnarta, dehi tikkuna al yeda deaharon, deha leella menarta, vechol butzinin (sefer acher tikkunin) dilah, al yeda deaharon naharin kolla.
Ta chaze, madbecha, teresar nesiin havo lechannecha leh, uleatkkena leh, veha ukemuha teresar innun shevatin, led sitrin, 4 degalim, vechullehu teresar. vecholla kegavvna dilella. menarta
1333: Itmene beshiva butzinin, leadleka al yeda dechahana, vecholla kegavvna dilella. umenarta, al at kayyayma, uvenisa itavidat, veha ukemuha beovada dimnarta.

Umadbach penimaa, umenarta, kayyme kachada, lechedvavta decholla. dichtiv, (Mishlei 27:9) shemen uketoret yesammach lev. veokimna ditre madbechan havo, chad penimaa decholla, vehay kayyeyma lechedvavta. vechad levar, lekarva karbenin. umehay penimaa nafik lehay dilvar, uman dechame veyistakkal, yinda chachmeta illaa, raza demilla adonay yedod. veal da la itkerav ketarta, ella beshaata deshemen ishtechach.

Ashkachna besifra dishlomo malka, ketoret hu lechedva, ulesalleka motana. may taama. begin dedina mehay dilbar ishtechach, vechedvavta vechadu vekishshura dinhiru, mehahu penimaa, dechol chedu beh kayyeyma. vechad hay atar, kol dina istallak mehay, vela yachil lemebad dina. uvegin kach ketoret kayyeyma levattela motana, veal da, ketoret keshiru hu decholla, veda itkeriv behahu penimaa. zakkain innun yisrael bealma den uvealma deate, alayyhu ketiv (Yeshayahu 49:3) vayyomer li avdi atta yisrael vegomer.

(Bamidbar 8:6) kach et haleviyyim vegomer, ha ukemuha devae ledakkea (sefer acher ledabbera) lon, uleamshacha lon, leitkashshera beatrayyhu, begin deinnun deroa semala, vesitra dedina, vechol man deate missitra dedina, bae dela yarbe saara, begin deasge dina bealma. veal da itteta kehay gavvna, dela yitchaze saara levar, uvayay leitchappeyay reshe, ulechasse saraha, veokimna, veha ittemar. ucheden itbarchan kol innun deatyayn missitra dedina. veal da belevae ketiv, vecho taase lahem letaharam vegomer, veheeviru taar vegomer. veittemar levae la sallekin leatrayyhu, ad deyarim lon kahana, begin dimina madbar tadir lismala.

Rabbi shimon amar, beyoma desallekin levae beduchetayyhu, bitren parim. may tama parim. ella inhu kefarim, lekabbela bismala lehay para deikre para aduma. kahana kol chela vechol tikkuna beh talyay, begin dechol chela degufa bidroa yemina kayyeyma. veal da kahana deroa deyisrael kullehu havi. uveh kayyeyma leatkena kolla uleatkena alma (sefer acher may tama parim ella inhu semala kefarim lekabbela bismala. ta chaze kahana deroa yemina deyisrael kullehu hava uveh kayyeyma leittakna alma uleittakkana kolla begin dechol chela degufa bidroa yemina kayyeyma vechol tikkuna beh talyay) veim kol da, la ishtechach bilchodoy, ella begufa usemala, vegufa ikkara hu decholla.

(Bamidbar 8:24) zot asher lalviyyim vegomer. ta chaze, levaa bar chamesh veesrin shenin yiflach bar chamshin shenin selik leducheteh veitattar. vechamesh veesrin yiflach deha bar nash (sefer acher ta chaze levaa bar chamesh veesrin shenin leducheteh veitattar. vechamesh veesrin yiflach ad desalik ledarga dechamshin). kad salik lehay darga dechamshin shenin ulehala, nachit min tukepa deeshsha deveh, vechevan deeshsha vachamimuta itkarir, ha pagim lehahu atar deitkeshar beh.

Veod, dekala dezimra la itkeshar bahadeh kol kach. vekala bae dela yitpegam, ella bae leittakfa, deha baatar dedina takkif kayyeyma, vela bechalsha. uvegin kach bae dela yafgim hahu atar deitkeshar beh, deihu dina takkifa, vela chalsha, veal da la bae leachazaa chuleshata kelal bechol sitrin. zakkaa hu bar nash deishtaddal beorayyta, veyinda orchoy dekudesha berich hu, vela sate limina velismala, dichtiv (Hoshea 14:10) ki yesharim darche Adonai.

(Bamidbar 9:1) vaydabber Adonai el moshe bemidbar sinay vegomer. amar ribbi abba, may tama azhar lehon hacha al pischa, veha ittemar lehu bemitzrayim. ella bashshana hashshenit hava, deyisrael chashivu deha pesach lav ihu ella bemitzrayim, vechevan deavdu leh zimna chada bemitzrayim, chashivu dela itzterich yatir. ata kudesha berich hu veazhar lon aleh, dela yachshevun deha ka avar zimneh bemitzrayim, velo yitzterich. begin
1334: Kach bemidbar sinay bashshana hashshenit, leatkena lehu ledare darin.

Veaf al gav deha azhar lehu bemitzrayim, hasheta pakid lon zimna achara, behahu atar dechol pikudin deorayyta beh ityehivu. veal da bashshana hashshenit. may bashshana hashshenit bachodesh harishon. ella raza illaa hi, chad shana. vechad chodesh. ma ben hay lehay. chodesh: da sihara. shana: da shimsha, denahir lesihara. ucheden hava bezimna dechol pikudin deorayyta itmesaru beh.

Rabbi shimon amar, vavy lehahu bar nash deamar, deha orayyta ata leachazaa sippurin bealma, umillin dehedyote. dei hachi, afillu bezimna da, anan yachlin lemebad orayyta, bemillin dehedyote, uvishvacha yatir mikkullehu. i leachazaa milla dealma, afillu innun kafsire dealma, it benayyhu millin illain yatir. i hachi nezil abbatrayyhu, venabed minnayyhu orayyta, kehay gavvna. ella kol millin deorayyta, millin illain innun, verazin illain.

Ta chaze, alma illaa vealma tattaa bechad matkela itkalu. yisrael letatta, malache illae leella. malache illae ketiv behu, (Tehillim 104:4) ose malachav ruchot. (hay baatar illaa) beshaata denachtin letatta (af al gav denachtin), mitlabbeshe bilvusha dehay alma. vei lav mitlabbeshe bilvusha kegavvna dehay alma, la yachlin lemekam behay alma, vela savil lon alma. vei bemalache kach, orayyta devara lehu, uvara almin kullehu, vekayymin beginah, al achat kamma vechamma kevan denachtat lehay alma, i lav demitlabbesha behane levushin dehay alma, la yachil alma lemisbal.

Veal da hay sippur deorayyta, levusha deorayyta. ihu. man dechashiv dehahu levusha ihu orayyta mammash, vela milla achara, tippach rucheh, vela yehe leh chulaka bealma deate. begin kach amar david, (Tehillim 119:18) gal enay veabbita niflaot mittoratecha. ma ditchot levusha deorayyta.
Ta chaze, it levusha deitchaze lecholla, veinnun tippeshin kad chaman levar nash bilvusha deitchaze lon shappira, la mistakkelin yattir. chashivu dehahu levusha, gufa, vachashivu degufa, nishmeta.

Kehay gavvna orayyta, it lah gufa, veinnun pikkude orayyta, deikrun gufe tora. hay gufa mitlabbesha bilvushin, deinnun sippurin dehay alma. tippeshin dealma, la mistakkele ella behahu levusha, deihu sippur deorayyta, vela yade yattir, vela mistakkele bema deihu techot hahu levusha. innun deyadin yattir, la mistakkelan bilvusha, ella begufa, deihu techot hahu levusha. chakkimin avde demalka illaa, innun dekayymu betura desinay, la mistakkele ella benishmeta, deihi ikkara decholla orayyta mammash. (ulealma) ulezimna deate, zeminin leistakkela benishmeta denishmeta deorayyta.

Ta chaze, hachi name leella, it levusha, vegufa, venishmeta, venishmeta lenishmeta. shemayya vechelehon. illen innun levusha. ucheneset yisrael, da gufa, dimkabbela lenishmeta, deihi tiferet yisrael. veal da ihu gufa lenishmeta. nishmeta deamaran da tiferet yisrael, deihi orayyta mammash. venishmeta lenishmeta, da ihu attika kaddisha. vecholla achid da beda.

Vavy leinnun chayyayvayya, deamre deorayyta lav ihi ella sippura bealma, veinnun mistakkele bilvusha da vela yattir. zakkain innun tzaddikayyay, demistakkele beorayyta kaddeka yeut. chamra la yativ ella bekankan. kach orayyta la yetiv ella bilvusha da. veal da la bae leistakkela, ella bema deit techot levusha. veal da kol innun millin, vechol innun sippurin, levushin innun.

(Bamidbar 9:2-3) veyaasu vene yisrael et happasach bemoado may veyaasu. amar ribbi yose, ha ittemar, kol man deachze ovada letatta kadka yeut, keillu avid leh leella. deha begineh ittear hahu milla, kivyachol, keillu hu avid leh, veha ittemar.
1335: (Bamidbar 9:10) ish ish ki yihye tame vegomer. ish ish tere zimne, amay, ella ish dehu ish, veyitchaze lekabbela nishmeta illaa, vehu pagim garmeh. dela sharyay aloy shechinta (sefer acher sheruta) (sefer acher nishmeta) illaa. may tama. begin deihu garim, vehu mesaev leh legarmeh. veal da ish ish. ish deyitchaze lemehevi ish, vehu mesaev garmeh, dela yishre aloy kedushsha dilella.

(Bamidbar 9:10) o vederech rechoka, da ihu chad measra deinnun nekudim beorayyta, vechullehu atyayn leachazaa milla. may vederech rechoka. begin debar nash deihu masiv garmeh, mesaavin leh leella. kevan dimsaavin leh leella, ha ihu bederech rechoka. mehahu atar vearcha dezara deyisrael achidan beh, ha bederech rechoka achid, deitrechak (nusach acher malemakerab) lemikrav lechon, uleitkashshera bechon, kema deattun mitkashsherin.

Amar ribbi yitzchak, veha ketiv ki yihye tame lanefesh o vederech rechoka, deitchaze teren millin. mashma dichtiv o. amar ribbi yose, kan, ad la mesaavin leh. kan, batar dimsaavin leh. umashma afillu hay, o hay, la yishre aloy kedushsha dilella, vela yaavdun pischa bezimna deyisrael avdin leh.
Vei tema, ha beyarcha tinyayna avid i la metakken garmeh. la, ella kevan demitaddeche umetakken garmeh, ha yarcha tinyayna lemebad pischa. michan, kol bar nash dimdache garmeh, medakkan leh.

Dei tema divdarga illaa yatir kaim beyarcha tinyayna. lav hachi, deha yisrael zara kaddisha deavdu pischa bezimneh, natlu leh lesihara uleshimsha kechad. uman denatil yesoda bekadmita, natil binyayna. may yesoda. la tema yesoda illaa detzaddika dealma, ella yesoda deeven tava, kema deat amer (Tehillim 118:22) even maasu habbonim hayta lerosh pina. vehay hu even deshari aleh man deshare.

Amar ribbi yehuda, vadday kolla natil afillu beyarcha tinyayna. aval lav ihu keman denatil leh bezimneh. may taama. da denatil pischa bezimneh, natil mittatta leella, vela nachit. begin demaalin bakkodesh, vela moridin. veda denatil batar zimneh,
1336: Nachit meella letatta. begin kach shavyan becholla, vela shavyan. deda salik vela nachit, veda nachit vela salik. begin kach man dimkarev pischa bezimneh, shevacha yatir it leh. zakkain innun yisrael, dezakkan becholla, dezakkan beorayyta, vechol man dezache beorayyta, zache leh bishma kaddisha. zakkain innun yisrael, bealma den uvealma deate.

Raya mehemna pikkuda lemebad pesach sheni, al innun dela yachilu, o deisteavu bimsaavu achara. i raza defesach, raza dimhemnuta deyisrael alin bah, shalta benisan, ucheden ihu zimna lechedva, ech yachlin illen dela yachilu, o deisteavu, lemebad beyarcha tinyayna, deha abar zimna.

Ella kevan dekneset yisrael mitatra beitraha benisan, la itadiat kitraha veitraha minnah telatin yomin. vechol innun 30 yomin min yoma denafku yisrael mippesach yatva matronita beitraha, vechol chelaa bechedva. man devae lemecheme lematronita, yachil lemecheme. karoza kariz, kol man dela yachil lemecheme matronita, yete veyechme ad la yinalun tare. ematay karoza kariz. bearbaa asar leyarcha tinyayna, deha mittamman ad shiva yomin, tarin petichan. mikkan ulehala yinalun tare. veal da pesach sheni. (ad kan) (pikkuda da lispor sefirat haomer 97 amud alef)

Pikkuda da, shechitat happesach bizmanno. vaabbatreh pesach rishon ufesach sheni leechol otan kemishpatan. utemeim lihyot nidchim lefesach sheni, deihu pikkuda telitaa. tanain vaamorain, it bene nasha kechulin detahara, missitra demichael. uchechulin dehekdesh, kegon besar kodesh, veinnun missitra degavriel. kohen velevi. veit bene nasha deinnun keyomin tavin, veinnun kodesh kodashim.

Shechinta ihi pesach rishon, mimina. ufesach sheni, missemala. pesach rishon mimina, detamman chachma. pesach sheni missemala, detamman bina. uvegin devigvura mitabberin kol eshshin nucherain, deinnun kekkash veteven legabbe esh digvura, temeim nidchim lefesach sheni.

Vechol tumea nidda, umetztzora, vezav vezava veyoledet, beeshsha digvura ihu soref. denishmeta ihu mana dekudesha berich hu, veihu la share bah, ad deitlabbenat beeshsha digvura, dichtiv, (Yirmeyahu 23:29) halo cho devari kaesh neum Adonai. uvehay eshsha, im barzel hu mitpotztzetz, veim even hu nimoach.

Uvimina (nusach acher uvemmaya) detamman tora shebbichtav, deihi mayim, (Vayikra 12:7) vetahara mimmekor dameha, veitdakke bah metztzora, vetame met, vezav vetame bechol mine sheretz. hada hu dichtiv, (Yechezkel 33) vezarakti alechem mayim tehorim utehartem vegomer.

Beammuda deemtztzaita mana ityachadat bevalah, deihi itteta, batar deitkaddeshat bismala, veitdakkeat beme mikve bimina, veomrim al mane defischa, kelim shennishtammeshu bahen betztzonen, matbilan betztzonen, vehen tehorim. innun nishmatin deinnun missitra derachame, veinnun rachamanim, mare chinna vechisda, la tzerichin leadkea bemayim poshrim kabbenoniyyim. kol shekken bechamme chammin, divhon mitdachin reshaim gemurim, dimchammemin garmayyhu beeshsha deyitztzer hara. vealayyhu ittemar, kol davar asher yavo vaesh. begin dezuhama dilhon nefisha. aval tzadikim gemurim betztzonen. dealayyhu ittemar, kol hammesim revach ben haddevekim, metztzannenim leh gehinnam.

Vei nishmatin chamriyyim, deinnun kemane cheres, sheviratan zo hi taharatan. kema deat amer nishbaru, nitharu. veraza demilla, (Tehillim 51:19) zivche elohim ruach nishbara vegomer. aval innun demishtaddelin beorayyta devichtav uveorayyta debal pe, deinnun esh umayim, veinnun demishtaddelin beraze deorayyta, deihu or, dichtiv bah, (Mishlei 6:23) vetora or, beorayyta innun mitdachin ba.

Veod beferek haroe, haroe temarim bachalom, tammu avonotav. hada hu dichtiv, (Eicha 4:22) tam avonech bat tziyyon. begin ditmarim, beh tam, darga deyaakov, deittemar beh, (Bereshit 25:27) veyaakov ish tam. chovin marim, veal da temarim: tamman tam, vetamman mar.

Hacha ramiz, vayimteku hammayim. hada hu dichtiv, (Shemot 15:25) vayyorehu Adonai etz vayimteku hammayim. mehacha, man deishtedal beorayyta, deihu etz. chovin dileh, deittemar behon (Shemot 1:14) vaymararu et chayyihem baavoda kasha, kudesha berich hu machil leh, veyitchazrun metikin.

Deyomin yetun, deyitkayyaym behu kemafkanu demitztzerayim, deittemar beh (Shemot 1:6) vayyamat yosef vechol echav vechol haddor hahu. uvegaluta batraa, let mita ella oni deani chashuv kammet. lekayyem behon (Tzefanya 3:12) vehisharti bach am ani vadal vechasu beshem Adonai. leitkayyeyma behon (Shmuel 2 22:28) veet am ani toshia. veillen atirim deyishtaarun behon yitkayyem behon, (Shemot Adonai:17) nirpim attem nirpim. nirpim hem beorayyta. nirpim hem, lemebad tivu im mare tora. veanshe chayil hamesovvim meir lair vela yechunnanu.

Venirpim hem bechoved hammas, dei tema kevedin innun bechoved hammas, vela avdin tivu, begin da tichbad haavoda al haanashim veyyaasu ba, dechoved hammas alayyhu, veal yishu bedivre shaker, deinnun meshakkerin veamrin dechoved hammas alayyhu, uvegin da la yaavdun tivu. innun meshakran bemillulayyhu, veamrin demehakkoved detichbad alayyhu, teven en nittan, mamona deshikra, deveh toin (sefer acher shuin) lekudesha berich hu uvegin dela yishun beh, vela chasu beshem Adonai, en nittan laavadecha.
Veillen deit lon, tamir veganiz mamona millego, deihu tochen, kegon toch haotztzar veteva, itkayyaym behu vetochen levenim tittenu. veda kesafim levanim, dihon behahu dara.

Behahu zimna (Shemot 15:23) sham sam lo chok umishpat, veinnun mare mishna. uf hacha vayavou marata, ithadar lon orayyta dival pe, mara bedachakin sagiin, baaniuta, deyitkayyaym behu, (sham 1) vaymararu et chayyehem baavoda kasha: zo kusheya. bechomer: da kal vachomer. uvilvenim: da libbun halacha. uvechol avoda bassade: da barayyta. et kol avodatam asher avdu vahem befarech: da teku.

Veraya mehemana, tamman itkayyaym bach, sham sam lo chok umishpat vesham nissahu. uvehay etz haddaat tov vara, deihu isur vehetter. uveinnun razin deitgalleyayn al yedach, vayyimteku hammayim. kammelach demamtekat bisra, hachi yitmattekun berazyay deitgalleyayn al yedach, kol innun kusheyayn umachlokot, demayin meriran deorayyta dival pe, ithadaru metikan me orayyta, veyisurin dilach, berazin illen deitgalleyayn al yedach, yehon lach metikin, vihadrun lach kol dachakin dilach, kechelmin deavrin. vachalom, behifuch atvavn melach. demamtekat yat bisra. uf yissurin mematkim. kema deukemuha.
Velarshaim mithadran yisurin melach sedomit, deihi mesamme et haenayim, lekayyeyma behu (Iyov 11:20) veene reshaim tichlena. veinnun
1337: Erev rav rashshiayyay, deyitkayyaym behu behahu zimna, (Daniel 12:10) yitbarru veyitlabbenu veyitztzarfu rabbim vehirshiu reshaim. yitlabbenu: innun mare mishna. veyitztzarfu: innun zara kadisha dishar amma. hada hu dichtiv, (Zecharya 13:9) utztzeraftim kitztzerof et hakkesef. vehirshiu reshaim, innun erev rav.

(Daniel 12:10) vehamaskilim yavinu, innun mare kabbala, deittemar behon (Daniel 12:3) vehamaskilim yazhiru kezohar harakia. illen innun deka mishtaddelin bezohar da, deikre sefer hazzohar, deihu ketevat noach, demitkanneshin bah shenayim meir, vesheva mimmalchuta. ulezimnin echad meir, ushenayim mimmishpacha. divhon yitkayyem (Shemot 1:22) kol habben hayyillod hayyeora tashlichuhu. veda ora desifra da, vecholla al sibba dilach.

Uman garim da. orev deant tehe behahu zimna, kayyona. deshaliach achara deikre bishmach, kaorev deishtelach bekadmita, vela ithadar bishlichuta, deishtedal bashshekatztzim, deittemar behon, amme haaretz sheketz. begin mamona dilhon, vela ishtaddal bishlichuteh leahadra letztzadikayyay betiuveta. keillu la avid shelichuta demareh.

Uvach yitkayyem raza deyona, deal beimkin dithome yamma, hachi teul ant baamiku dithome orayyta, hada hu dichtiv, (Yona 2:4) vattashlicheni metztzula bilvav yammim. veyihon chachma chesed netztzach liymin. divginayyhu amar david, (Tehillim 118:15-16) yemin Adonai osa chayil yemin Adonai romema yemin Adonai osa chayil. utelat missemala yitkashsherun kachada, deinnun bina gevura hod. veg dargin deemtztzaita, keter tiferet yesod, daachidan bimina usemala.

Uvegin dechaza lach navi mitkashshar bitlat dargin deemtztzaita, patach alach hay kera, (Yeshayahu 52:13) hinne yaskil avdi yarum venissa vegava meod. uvegin deant tehe achid bitren meshichin, amar david al 3 yeminin demashiach ben david, yemin Adonai telat zimnin. lokovel 3 semalin, deachid behon mashiach ben efrayim, amar missitra dechad semala, gevura, lo amut. ki echye, missitra dismala dehod dilach, deittemar beh venitan hahod lemoshe. ityeyhiv bach, missitra devina.

Begin deveh havit ant charev veyavesh becholla, begin mashiach ben efrayim, beorayytach, binviutach aleh, begufach disvilat kama mine yissurin, begin dela yemut hu. uvait rachame aleh. ittemar beh ki echye, missitra devina. uvegin da la amut, missitra digvura. ki echye missitra devina, ilana dechayyi, deitgabbar aleh keriat shema shel shacharit, vekashir leh bekishshura ditfillin, bimina deavraham, deihu shacharit.

Vaasapper maase yah, missitra dehod. yassor yisseranni yah, chachma uvina, mimina umissemala, bitlat yeminin, utelat semalin. velammavt lo netanani, ammuda deemtztzaita, beg dechalil keter, vetztzadik, veihu ben yah. umiyyad yakum 6 laAdonai beyah, bimina usemala, berachame vetachanune, bechamma piyyusim lah velivnaha, hada hu dichtiv, (Amos 9:11) bayom hahu akim et sukkat david hannofelet. uvegin da amar navi, (Yirmeyahu 31:9) bivchi yavou uvetachanunim ovilem.

Kam raya mehemna, venashik leh, uvarich leh, veamar vadday shelicha demarach ant legabban. patchu tanain vaamorain veamru, raya mehemana, ant havit yeda kol da, veal yedach hi itgalyay, aval baanava dilach, deittemar bach (Bamidbar 12:3) vehaish moshe anav meod, beillen atrin deant mitbayyish leachzeka tivu legabbach, manni kudesha berich hu lan, ulevutztzina kaddisha, lemehevi bidach uvefumach beillen atrin. (ad kan raya mehemana) (78 amud alef pikkuda batar da vechulei)

(Bamidbar 9:15) uveyom hakim et hammishkan. ribbi chiyyay patach, (Tehillim 112:9) pizzar natan laevyonim tzidkato omedet laad karno tarum vechavod. pizzar laevyonim, may pizzar. kema deat amer (Mishlei 11:24) yesh mefazzer venosaf od. yachol pizzur bealma, ka mashma lan pizzar natan laevyonim, kevan deyahiv lemiskene, hay pizzura yaut. may venosaf od. becholla. venosaf od beutera. venosaf od bechayye.

Hay kera hachi mibbae leh, yesh mefazzer veyosef od, may venosaf. ella hahu atar deshare beh mita, hu garim leh deyitosaf mechayim dilella leosfa leh. amar ribbi yehuda amar ribbi chiyyay, kera ashid, dechol man deyahiv lemiskene, itar ilana dechayye, leosfa lehahi ilana demota, ucheden ishtechach chayyim vechedu leella. uvar nash degarim da, beshaata deitzterich leh, hahu ilana dechayye kaim aleh, vehahu ilana demota aggin aloy. uvegin kach venosaf od. (kema deat amar)
1338: Omedet laad. may omedet laad. omedet aleh devar nash, lezammena leh kiuma vechayyim, kema deihu yahiv leh chayyim, veatar legabbe chayyin, hachi name yahavin leh. veinnun tere ilanin (yahavin leh) kayymin aleh leshezava leh, uleosfa leh chayyin.
Karno tarum vechavod, ta chaze alma deamaran, hahu (120 amud alef) keren tarum. uvema. vechavod dilella, dehay bar nash garim lechabbera lon kachada, ulearka birchan leella vetata.

Ribbi abba amar, bechol zimna demashkena ittekam beovadehon divne nasha, keden hahu yoma, yoma dechedvav decholla, umashach revut kadisha itrak behanehu botzinin, venaharin kullehu. man degarim da, garim leh (behahu alma deate) deyishteziv behay alma, vihe leh chayyim bealma deate, hada hu dichtiv, (Mishlei 11:4) utzedaka tatztzil mimmavt, uchetiv (Mishlei 4:18) veorach tzadikim keor noga holech vaor ad nechon hayyom.

(Bamidbar 10:2) ase lecha shete chatzotzrot kesef vegomer. ribbi shimon patach, (Yechezkel 1:19) uvelechet hachayyot yelchu haofannim etzlam uvehinnase hachayyot meal haaretz yinnasu haofannim. uvelechet hachayyot, bekuzefira dilella havo azle. dei tema dehay leella leella. lav, letatta. ella kegavvna hay mikkamme anpin, vehay levatar anpin.

Zika mearba zikin, bed madorin, uved sitrin, bezivavn deitberun bekolmitin deanpin nehirin. begin kach keen (551) kemare hachayyot, deinnun arva zivyayn, degalin perisan, arye. nesher. shor. adam. dechalil kullehu 4 malachin deshaltin uchelilan kolla.

Digla kadmaa, mashirya mizzayyna, arye. michael, rashim bifrishu digla perisha limina. mizrach sheruta deshimsha, azil bematlanoy, binhiru. teren memanan techot yedeh, yofiel, tzadkiel. chad leureta (nusach acher leorayyta). vechad, lemehach beshuka deazil

Kad illen natlin, natlin kama mashshiryayn mezayyeynin, missitra dimina, vecholla chad. lesitra semala, shimsha azil (sefer acher natal kad chad listar shimsha, shimsha azil) venahir, umeatter lehu. elef verivvavn memanan techotoy. vechullehu bidchilu beemata bezia beretet.
Arye oshit yedeh yemina, kanish lechol cheloy legabbeh, telat mea veshivin elef aryevavta, socharaneh dehahu arye, veihu benayyhu beemtzaita.

Kad gae hay arye, mizdazean rekiin, vechol chayyalin umashiryayn mizdazein, middechilu dileh. mehahu kala, nehar di nur mitlahata, venachit beelef vachamesh mea dargin degehinnam letatta, keden kullehu chayyayvin degehinnam mizdazean, umelahatan eshsha, veal da ketiv, (Amos 3:8) arye shaag mi lo yira.

Gae tinyaynut, telat mea veshivin elef aryevavta, kullehu gaan. oshit yedeh semala, kol marehon dedina letatta dachalin, veitkafyayn techot hahu yeda. vehahu yeda pashit alayyhu, vechullehu techoteh. kema deat amer, (Bereshit 49:8) yadcha beoref oyvecha.
Arba gadpin lechol chad vechad, meeshsha chivvavra. kullehu melahatin. kol appin dechizzur veshushan bechivavrta dehahu eshsha shekian.

Arba anpin lechol chad vechad learba sitrin, kullehu nehirin bechivvavra deshimsha. chad listar mizrach, nahir bechedu. vechad listar maarav, (sefer acher da kanish) deitkenish nehoreh. vechad listar tzafon, chashuch bela nehiru, ketzila deshimsha legabbe shimsha. tzilla chashuch, shimsha nahir. begin deshimsha vetzila, yemina usemala, veazla kachada. chashochan (sefer acher chusheban) deazlin immeh, kol innun denatlin zayyna.

Vechullehu mimina umissemala bitlat reshin. resha chada dileh, shivin vearba elef, veshit mea. illen innun resha chad. nafke chela bimina, deihu arim alayyhu. bar kol innun memanan diltatta, techot illen. shiltonin illen al illen, dargin tattain im illain, delet lon chushebana.
Resha tinyayna, deazil beresha kadmaa, chusheban dileh chamshin vearba elef, vearba mea. bar kol
1339: Illen memanan ditchot led sitrin, delet lon chushebana. resha telitaa, deazil batrayyhu, chamshin veshiva elef, vearba mea. kegavvna denatil yemina, hachi name natil semala, hachi name mikkammayyhu, hachi name mibbatrayyhu.
Kevan denatil hay kadmaa, vehurad hammishkan. vechullehu levave amre shirata, mare detushebchan kullehu missitreh. keden (Yechezkel 1:21) ki ruach hachayya baofannim ketiv.

Digla tinyayna. mashiryay mizzayyna, nesher, uriel, darom. tere memanan immeh, shamshiel chasdiel. hay nesher salik, vechol marehon degadpin mikkammeh. kama mashiryayn sallekin bechol sitrin. kol chad vechad betukefa deshimsha.

Rucha derucha penimaa nafik, vehahu rucha mate lehay nesher, vesalik evroy umechasseyay legufa. kema deat amer, (Iyov 39:26) hamibbinatcha yaaver netz yifros kenafav leteman. kegavvna kedugema keen kenesher yair kinno hay nesher netz bahadeh yona, bahadeh netz, vechol mare degadpin kullehu metzaftzefan vechaddan. chad missitra (sefer acher chad samcha) kammeh, salik mittatta leella. kama tzipparin nachtin vealin, metzaftzefan vechaddan, azlin veshatin.

Kad natil, oshit gadpa yemina, kanish lechol cheloy, telat mea vechamshin elef mare degadfin, bitre gufe, nesher vearye kachada. arim kala, kullehu acharanin sallekin venachtin, metzaftzefan missitrayyhu, mikkamma dargin.

3 Reshin innun kachada, bemashshiryayn illen. vechullehu bechad chusheban. vechusheban deillen reshin, resha chada, arbein veshit elef vachamesh mea. resha tinyana chamshin vetesha elef utelat mea. resha telitaa, arbein vachamesh alfin, veshit mea vechamshin.

Meillen tere sitrin, nafik teren karoze, deazle mikkamme kullehu mashshiryayn. kad illen tere machrize, kol chelin, vechol mashiryayn, chevavn zeirin im ravrevan, kullehu mitkanneshe. man chame netila dechullehu rekiin, kullehu natlin bematula bemashiryayn, lekammeh dehahu mashkena.

Beshaata dechad minnayyhu, hahu deate missitra dearye, pashit kala, begin dela yizdazeun kol innun kalin. keden mitkanneshin kol innun mashiryayn. beshaata deachara kare, mattebar kala vela pashit, kol innun mashiryayn dehay nesher, kullehu mitkanneshu lenatla bematalnayyhu. lokovel innun, shete chatzotzrot kesef, kegavvna da kolla letatta. ta chaze, kad illen natlin ma ketiv, (Yechezkel 1:19) uvelechet hachayyot yelchu haofannim etzlam, innun demitkanneshu legabbayyhu, kegavvna deresha istekal, hachi name kullehu.

Digla telitaa. shor. gavriel. tzafon. teren memanan immeh, kaftziel chizkiel. hay shor missitra dismala. karnoy sallekin ben teren enoy. ragiz beistakkeluta, ayynin melahatan keeshsha denur dalik. nagach verafsa beragloy vela chayis.

Kad gae hay shor, nafkin minukeba dithoma rabba, kama chavile sherikin (sefer acher terikin), kullehu gaan veshatan kameh, vechemata, veachmeta dechol chovin talyay kameh, deha kol chove alma, kullehu besifra selikin uchetivin.

Shiva nahare deeshsha nagdin kammeh, kad tzache azil legabbe hahu nehar dinur, veshaiv leh bigmia chada. vehahu nahar itmele kidbekadmeta, vela kadiv. kol innun chayyaylin, shaavin eshsha achla eshsha. veilmale demissitra dearye, nafik chad nahara demayay, dimchabbin gachalatayyhu, la yachil alma lemisbal.

Chashocha deshimsha tamman ishtechach, la ishtechach nehiru. kama gardine nimusin azlin veshatan bechashocha vehahu nahar dedalik besitra da, nura uchama chashuch. vei tema, dela it eshsha chivvavra, eshsha uchama, eshsha sumaka, eshsha ditre gevavne. la tema, deha vadday hachi hu, veim kol da leella leella hachi ishtechach, umittamman nagid leillen tattae.
Tanenan orayyta bema ishtechachat. eshsha chivvavra, veeshsha uchama al gabbe eshsha chivvavra. bitre ishshe ishtechachat orayyta. ta chaze, eshsha chada hu, vehay itpelig learbaa. mayya chada
1340: Ihu, vehay itpelig learba. rucha chada ihu, vehay itpelig learba.

Telat reshin ishtechachu (sefer acher itchabbaru) bemashreyayn illen. chusheban dilhon, resha chada shittin utere elef usheva mea. resha 2, arbein vechad elef vachamesh mea. resha telitaa, telat vechamshin elef vearba mea. bar kol innun dargin acharanin deitparshan besitrayyhu, velet lon chushebana. kullehu dargin al dargin. bar kama gardine nimusin deinnun letatta, chatzifin kechalba, nashchin kechammara, vavy man deishtechach gabbayyhu, vedina dilhon besitra reviaa.

Digla reviaa, adam refael. maarav. bahadeh asvavta. besitra deadam itkelil dina illaa aleh attese. hay (sefer acher chad) achid bekarnoy deshor, kad mibbae leaala lon lithoma rabba. vechafit lon, dela yokid alma. batar da sharya kol demama dakka dina. (sefer acher hacha) milla bachashay, la mishtema milla dehavara kelal.

Besitra da, sharya man desharya, salik man desalik, shimsha itkenish leanhara lehay atar. begin kach utekatem terua, bistar darom. aval hacha, lav hay velav hay. amay terua. leachpeyay setar tzafon, uvegin kach setar tzafon laachora.

Ta chaze, shete chatzotzrot, begin deinnun missitre tere dekaamre, mimmizrach umiddarom. inhu zeminin letavra dinin, uleachpeyay lon. veal da innun mikkesef. uvegin kach uveyom simchatchem uvemoadechem vegomer, utekatem bachatzotzrot, setam, ben leella ben letatta. zakkain innun yisrael, dekudesha berich hu bae bikarehon, veyahiv lon chulaka illaa al kol shear ammin. vekudesha berich hu ishtebach behu betushebachtayyhu, hada hu dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 49:3) vayyomer li avdi atta yisrael vegomer.

(Bamidbar 10:35) vayhi binsoa haaron vayyomer moshe vegomer. ribbi elazar amar, hacha it leistakkela, 50 deihi (sefer acher manevazeraa) mechazra laachora hacha bitre duchete, amay. vei tema 50 kefufa, ha yedia 50 kefufa nukeba. 50 peshuta, kelala didchar venukeba. veha okimna baatar da, vayhi binsoa haaron. amay ithaddar levatar kegavvna da.

Ta chaze, 50 beashre yoshve vetecha la ittemar, begin dehi begaluta. veha ukemuha chavrayyay dichtiv, (Amos Adonai:2) nafla lo tosif kum betulat yisrael vegomer. ella ma ketiv leella, vaaron berit Adonai nosea lifnehem derech sheloshet yamim latur lahem menucha. kevan dehava natil arona, nun natil aleh (nusach acher immeh), veha shechinta al gabbe arona yetiv. ta chaze, chavivuta dekudesha berich hu legabbayyhu deyisrael, deha af al gav deinnun satan meorach meshar, kudesha berich hu la bae leshavka lon, uvechol zimna ahdar anpoy lokovlayyhu, dei lav hachi la yekumun bealma.
