Ta chaze, arona hava natal kammayyhu oreach telata yomin, 50 la hava mitperash minneh, venatil immeh. umiggo rechimu dilhon deyisrael, ahdar anpoy veistechar millegabbe arona, kehay ayyayla deazalta, kad ihu azil, ahdar appoy laatar denafik. veal da binsoa haaron, nun aschar anpin lokovlayyhu deyisrael, vechatfe gufa legabbe arona.

Veal da kad arona hava natil, moshe amar kuma Adonai, la tishbok lon, ahdar anpach legabban, keden nun ithaddar legabbayyhu kegavvna da keman dimhaddar anpe leman derachim, vechad hava share arona (veyisrael) lemishre, keden ahdar nun anpoy miyisrael, veithaddar legabbe arona, uvecholla ithaddar.

Amar ribbi shimon, elazar, bevday hachi hu, aval hacha la ahdar anpoy miyisrael, dei hachi bae nun leithappecha miggavvna deachara illaa (sefer acher dilella), hay menuzar laachora vehay beorach meshar legabbe arona.

Ella vday la ahdar anpoy minnayyhu, uma avid beshaata deshari arona lemishre. amar moshe shuva Adonai, keden share arona, ushechinta kaim besitra achara, veanpin lokovlayyhu deyisrael, velokovleh daarona. (uvegin kach) ucheden kolla kalil (legavvav) lechavvevna,
1341: Laarona, uleyisrael. ella deyisrael garmu levatar, dichtiv vayhi haam kemitonnim.

Amar ribbi elazar, ana deamaran missifra derav yeva sava, deamar deven behay gisa, uven behay gisa, ithaddar. amar leh, shappir kaamar, aval da daamena, hachi tishkach besifra derav hamenuna sava, vehachi hu vadday.

Vehaman (Bamidbar 11:7) kizra gad hu. amar ribbi yose, lekayyeyma zara vechelin beara, kema deat amer (Bereshit 49:19) gad gedud yegudennu. ma zara degad natle chulakehon beara achara, kach man sharya alayyhu deyisrael, levar meara kaddisha.

Davar acher kizra gad hu. kezara degad chivvavra, veikpe kad nachit laavira, veitnegris (sefer acher vaatageshaym) (sefer acher vaatabelaa) begufa, veha ukemuha chavrayyay. veeno keen habbedolach, kehahu bedolcha deihu chivvavr, kegavvna dimina (sefer acher chayvaveraa deena) dilella. (kezera gad hachi lo ikrun beara demitzrae aval lechach macherashey zareyaa kezera gad hu kezera gida chivvavra vaatakepayh kad nachit milleella letatta)

Amar ribbi yitzchak, may shena (deamar) demoshe bemilla da (chalish) leella kenukeba, dichtiv im kacha at ose li, at, atta mibbae leh. ella laatar demota share beh kaamar, vehahu atar denukeba ihu. begin kach amar hargeni na harog, veda ilana demota. veha okimna divilana dechayye la sharyay beh mota. veal da ithaddar legabbe ilana demota veamar at, vela amar atta, vehachi mibbae leh.

Miyyad (Bamidbar 11:16) vayyomer Adonai el moshe esfa li shivim ish vegomer. amar leh kudesha berich hu, at bae mota bechol zimna, hare lach, veatzalti min haruach vegomer. ta chaze, dehacha yada moshe deihu yamut, vela yeul leara, deha eldad umedad milla da havo amre.

Al da, la live leh leeynash, beshaata derugeza share beh, lelatyay garmeh. deha kama kayyme aleh dimkabbele hahi milla. bezimna ocharana devaa mita, la kabbilu minneh. begin decholla letoalta deyisrael hava. hashsheta lav ihu, ella miggo rugeza vedochaka, uvegin kach kabbilu mineh. veal da ishtaaru levatar eldad umedad, veamru da, demoshe yitkenish, vihoshua yeul lon leyisrael leara.

Uvegin kach ata yehoshua legabbe moshe, vekkane aleh demoshe. umoshe la ashgach bikara dileh. veal da amar, adoni moshe kelaem. may kelaem. mana minnehon innun millin, kema deat amer (Shemot 36:6) vayyikkale haam mehavi. (Bereshit 8:2) vayyikkale haggeshem min hashshamayim. meniuta mammash. umoshe la baa. puk chame anvavtanuteh demoshe, ma ketiv hamekanne atta li vegomer. zakkaa chulakeh demoshe, deihu salik al kullehu nevie illae (nusach acher dealma). amar ribbi yehuda, kol shear neviin legabbe moshe, kesihara legabbe shimsha.

Ribbi abba hava yativ lelya chad, velae beorayyta. vahavu immeh ribbi yose veribbi chizkiyya. amar ribbi yose, kama innun bene nasha takifu libba, dela mashgeche bemille dehahu alma kelum. amar ribbi abba, bisra delibba, daachida bechol shayyfe gufa, ka avid lon. patach veamar, (Kohelet 6:1) yesh raa asher raiti tachat hashshamesh verabba hi al haadam. yesh raa: da ihi tukepa bisha delibba, devae leshalletaa bemille dehay alma, vela ashgach bemille dehahu alma midi.

Amay ihi raa. kera devatreh ochach, dichtiv ish asher yitten lo haelohim osher unechasim vegomer. hay kera kashya, kevan dichtiv veenennu chaser lenafsho mikkol asher yitavve, amay velo yashlitennu haelohim leechol mimmennu, deha eno chaser lenafsho kelum ella. raza ihu, vechol milloy dishlomo malka, mitlabbeshan innun bemillin acharanin, kemille deorayyta, deinnun mitlabbeshan besippure alma.
Ta chaze, af al gav devaenan leistakkela bilvusha, hasheta hay kera hachi kaamar, debar nash azil behay alma, veyahiv leh
1342: Kudesha berich hu utera, begin deyizke beh lealma deate, veyishtear legabbeh keren. may keren. hahu deihu kayyaym, deihu atar leittzarra beh nishmeta. begin kach bae leashara abbatreh (nusach acher utereh) lehay keren, vehay keren yekabbel leh, batar deyippok mehay alma.

Begin dehay keren, hu ilana dechayye dehahu alma, vela kayyeyma behay alma, ella hahu ibba denafik minneh, veal da ibba dileh achil bar nash, dezache behay alma, vehakkeren kayyeyma leh lehahu alma, lemizke beh bachayyin illain dilella.

Uman desaiv garmeh, veitmeshach batar garmeh, veleteh chaser lenafsheh ulegarmeh kelum. vehahu ilana ishtear, vela shavye lokovleh bidchilu, ulekabbela leh leella. keden velo yashlitennu haelohim leechol mimmennu, ulemizke behahu utera, vadday ish acher yochlennu, kema deat amer (Iyov 27:17) yachin vetzaddik yilbash. begin kach, bae bar nash lemizke, bema deyahiv leh kudesha berich hu lehahu alma, ucheden achil minneh behay alma, veyishtear legabbeh hahu keren lealma achara, lemehevi tzerora bitzrora dechayye. amar ribbi yose vadday.

Tu amar ribbi yose, ketiv im kacha at ose li hargeni na vegomer vechi moshe deihu anav mikkol bene alma, begin deshailu minneh yisrael lemechal, masar garmeh lammita, amay. amar ribbi abba, hay milla olifna, veraza illaa ihu, moshe la avish kammeh, vela shaal lammita al deshailu yisrael.

Ta chaze, moshe itachad, vahava salik bema dela itachad nevia achara. (deha achid tzedaka have) uveshaata deamar leh kudesha berich hu lemoshe, (Shemot 16:4) hinni mamtir lachem lechem min hashshamayim. chadde moshe veamar, vadday hasheta hahu shelimu bi ishtechach. deha beginay ishtechach man leyisrael. kevan dechama moshe deahadru lenachta ledarga achara, veshaillu basar, veamre venafshenu katza ballechem hakkelokel. amar i hachi hu, ha darga dili pagim. deha begini yechlun yisrael man bemadbera (181), ha ana pegima, veaharon pagim, venachshon ben aminadav pagim.

Amar veim kacha at ose li hargeni na harog, dachashivna nukeba bemechla dilah, (vaana nachit min shemayay deihu darga illaa, lenachta ledarga denukeba, vaana adif min shear nevie alma, veal da amar veel ere (achoti) beraati kammet vadday lenachta ledarga tattaa.

Keden vayyomer Adonai el moshe esfa li shivim ish. et shail atar demita lo tive atar dela tehe pagim bedarga dilach. veal da ketiv veatzalti min haruach asher alecha dechullehu inun detamman itachadu). (sefer acher vaana nachit min shemayay leara. et ose li lenachta laatar denukeba, valemapegam leatri vaderagey i hachi hargeni na harug im na matzati chen beenecha veel ere beraati. raati hi vadday leachada bedarga tattaa. keden vayyomer Adonai el moshe esfa li shivim ish mizzikne yisrael. ha inun lemittan lehu mechla achara, velo tehe pagim bedarga dilach. veal da veatzalti min haruach asher alecha vesamti alehem. may tama. begin deinnun itachadu besihara vechulei) besihara uvae shimsha leanhara lah. veal da vesamti alehem, begin leanhara min shimsha, kinhora desihara. (sefer acher uvegine hay mechla da, lo) atyay al yeda demoshe, begin dela yitpegim.

Zakkaa chulaka demoshe, dekudesha berich hu bae bikareh, aleh ketiv (Mishlei 23:25) yismach avicha veimmecha vegomer. yismach avicha: da kudesha berich hu. veimmecha: da keneset yisrael. vetagel yoladtecha: da imma demoshe diltatta. kudesha berich hu rachim leh yattir mikkol nevie alma, bela, emtzai kelal. (sefer acher deha moshe istallak al kol nevie alma belo emtzai kelal kema) dichtiv pe el pe adabber bo, veha okimna bechamma atar.
(Bamidbar 12:13) veyitzak moshe el Adonai lemor el na refa na lah. ha ukemuha, vehu raza dishma kaddisha, mechad sere atvavn, vela baa moshe letzallaa yattir, begin deal dideh lemalka la bae
1343: Leatrecha yattir. begin kach kudesha berich hu baa al yekara demoshe. uvechol atar kudesha berich hu baa al yekarehon detzaddikayyay, yattir al dileh. ulezimna deate, atid kudesha berich hu lemitba elbona deyisrael meammin ovde kochavim umazzalot, ulemechode lon bechedvavta detziyyon. dichtiv, (Yirmeyahu 31:12) uvau verinnenu vimrom tziyyon vegomer. ucheden (Yeshayahu 59:20) uva letziyyon goel vegomer. baruch Adonai leolam amen veamen. yimloch Adonai leolam amen veamen.
1344: Begavvivy, hasheta deant shimsha, hech yekumun kachada shimsha vesihara, la nahir sihara ella beshaata deitkenish shimsha, aval hasheta let annet yachil. i tive leminda minnah shelach lecha anashim, legarmach, begin leminda.

Ta chaze, moshe, i tema dehu la yada dela yeul leara bezimna da. lav hachi, ella yada, vahava bae leminda minnah, ad la yistalak, veshillach leillen mealle, kevan dela ativu milla kaddeka yaut, la shalach zimna achara, ad dekudesha berich hu achze leh, dichtiv, (Devarim 32:49) ale el har haavarim hazze uree et haaretz. uchetiv (Devarim 34:1) vayyarehu Adonai et kol haaretz. vela da bilchodoy, ella kol innun dizminin lemekam bechol dara vedara, kullehu achze leh lemoshe. veittemar, veokmuha chavrayyay.

Kevan deshari moshe lemishlach, ma amar lon. hayesh bah etz. vechi ma hu dekaamar, vei tema dela yada. (lekamman yema milla aval hacha) ella hachi amar moshe, im yesh bah etz, ha yedana daana iul letaman. may etz. da ilana dechayye. vetamman la hava ella began eden deara. amar im yesh bah etz da, ana iul letaman. vei la, lav ana yachil lemeal.

Amar ribbi chiyay, ketiv (Bamidbar 15:32) vayyimtzeu ish mekoshesh etzim beyom hashshabbat. man etzim hacha. uman hu da. ella da tzelafchad, vahava dayik al illen ilanin, he minnayyhu rav al achara, vela chashash likara demareh, veachlaf shabbat leshabbat. hada hu dichtiv, (Bamidbar 27:3) ki vecheto met, bechet 6 met. (veraza decholla vadday mekoshesh etzim) begin kach, hava dineh satim, vela itperash dineh. kedinin acharanin. begin demilla da bae bachashay vesatim vela galyay. veal da la ittemar beitgalyay, vekudesha berich hu avad yekar likareh.

Ribbi yose amar, shear etzim bahade shabbat hava mekoshesh, vekabbil onsha lefum shaata, veitkefar choveh. veal da itkashshe moshe bedina divnata, dela yada i itkappar lemehevi livnateh chulak veachasana i lav. kevan dedachar shemeh (datzelapechad) kudesha berich hu, dichtiv ken benot tzelafchad dovrot, ityeda deha itkappar choveh.

Ta chaze, 2 ilanin innun, chad leella, vechad letatta, beda chayyin, uveda mota. man deachlaf lon, garim leh mota behay alma, velet leh chulaka behahu alma. veal da amar shelomo, (Mishlei 25:16) devash matzata echol dayyekka vegomer.

Aron vetora bechad kayyme. tora ikkara, aron beta. veal da, aron chaser bela vav bechol atar, aron habberit, aron haedut. bechol atar aharon deroa yemina, bar bechad, dichtiv (Bamidbar 3:39) kol pekkude haleviyyim asher pakad moshe veaharon, nakud leella.

Amar ribbi yitzchak, moshe ilana dechayye nakat, veal da baa leminda, i hava shechiach beara, i lav, uvegin kach amar, hayesh bah etz im ayin vehitchazzaktem ulekachtem mipperi haaretz. deha ilana dechayye itchamad lecholla. veinnun la ayytiu ella anavim verimmonim uteenim, beilana achara talyayn vaachidan.

Ta chaze, (Bamidbar 13:2) shelach lecha anashim: beginach. ribbi yehuda patach, (Mishlei 25:13) ketzinnat sheleg beyom katzir tzir neeman lesholchav venefesh adonav yashiv. ketzinnat sheleg beyom katzir, deahane legufa ulenafsha. tzir neeman lesholchav, ellu kalev ufinchas dahavo sheliche mehemne legabbe yehoshua. venefesh adonav yashiv, deahadru shechinta ledayyeyra behu beyisrael, vela istalka minnayyhu.

Veillen deshadar moshe, gerimu bechiyay ledarin batrain, vegarimu leistalleka miyisrael kamma elef veribbevan. vegarimu lesalleka shechinta meara mibbenayyhu deyisrael. innun deshadar yehoshua, venefesh adonav yashiv.

Ribbi chizkiyya veribbi yesa havo azle bearcha, amar ribbi yesa leribbi chizkiyya. chamena beappach dehirhura it begavvavch. amar leh, ha vadday hay kera istakkalna beh, kevan deamar shelomo, (Kohelet 3:19) ki mikkere vene haadam umikre habbehema umikkere echad lahem vegomer. vetanenan, dechol milloy dishlomo malka, kullehu setimin middargin dechachmeta. i hachi, hay kera it beh leistakkela, deha pitcha leinnun delav bene
1345: Amar leh vadday hachi hu, veit beh leminda uleistakkela. addehachi chamu chad bar nash dehava ate, shaal lon mayyay, dehava tzache, vahava lae betukepa deshimsha. amru leh, man at. amar lon yuday ana, vaana lae vetzachena. amru lait beorayyta, amar lon, ad daana immechon bemillin, esllak lehay tura, vetamman essav mayyay veishte.

Appik ribbi yesa chad zefira male mayin, vihav leh. batar deshata, amar nesallek immach lemayyay. seliku letura, veishtechachu chad chuta demayay dakik, umalle katfura chad. yatvu. amar lon hahu bar nash, hasheta shailu, deha ana ishtaddallena beorayyta, al yedoy dechad beri, daana ayylit leh leve rav, uvegineh ravavchna beorayyta. amar ribbi chizkiyya i al yeda divrach, tav hu. aval milla daanan beh, ana chamena delaatar achara bae leistalleka. amar hahu bar nash, ema millach, dilzimnin beapparkasata deanyay tishkach marganita.

Amar leh hay kera deamar shelomo, sach leh. amar leh, vechi (nusach acher kema) bema attun perishan mishshear bene nasha dela yade. amru leh uvemma. amar lon, al da amar shelomo hay kera, vela amar hay miggarmeh, kishar innun millin. ella ahdar innun millin detippeshae alma deamre kach, umay amre. ki mikre haadam umikkere habbehema vegomer, tippeshae dela yade vela mistakkelan bechachmeta amre dehay alma azil bemikre, vekudesha berich hu la ashgach alayyhu, ella mikre haadam umikre habbehema umikre echad vegomer.

Vechad shelomo istakkal beillen tippeshain dekaamre da kara lon behema, deinnun avdin garmayyhu behema mammash, begin deamre millin illen. umenalan. kera dealeh ochach, dichtiv, (Kohelet 3:18) amarti ani belibbi al divrat bene haadam levaram haelohim velirot shehem behema hemma lahem. amarti ani belibbi vachashivna behay leistakkela al ma, al divrat bene haadam. al hahu milla detippeshuta, deinnun amre levaram haelohim bilchodayyhu, vela yitchabberun bahade bene nasha acharanin deit lon mehemnuta, velirot shehem behema hemma lahem. velirot behu innun bene mehemnuta, shehem behema mammash, vedatayyhu kivira. hemma lahem bilchodayyhu, vela leaala livne mehemnuta bedata detippeshuta da, veal da hemma lahem, vela leacharanin. uma data dilhon. ki mikkere vene haadam umikre habbehema umikkere echad lechullam vegomer. tippach ruchehon deinnun beire. innun tippeshae. innun mechusere mehemnuta. vavy lon vavy lenafshayyhu. tav lehu dela yetun lealma.

Uma ativ lon shelomo al da. kera abbatreh, veamar, umi yodea ruach bene haadam haola hi lemala veruach habbehema hayyoredet hi lematta laaretz. mi yodea beinnun tippeshae, dela yade bikara demalka illaa, vela mistakkele beorayyta, ruach bene haadam haola, hi lemala, laatar illaa, laatar yekar, laatar kaddisha, leittezna minnehiru illaa, minnehiru demalka kaddisha, lemehevi tzerora bitzrora dechayye, veishtechachat kamme malka kaddisha ola temima veda hu haola hi lemala.

Veruach habbehema hayyoredet hi lematta laaretz, velav lehahu atar dehava kol bar nash, dichtiv beh (Bereshit 9:6) betzelem elohim asa et haadam, uchetiv (Mishlei 20:27) ner Adonai nishmat adam. hech amre innun tippeshae delav mibbene mehemnuta, veruach echad lakkol, tippach ruchehon, alayyhu ketiv, (Tehillim 35:5) yihyu kemotz lifne ruach umalach Adonai doche. illen yishtaarun bagehinnam, leinnun dargin tattain, vela yistallekun ledare darin. alayyhu ketiv (Tehillim 104:35) yittammu chattaim min haaretz ureshaim od enam barachi nafshi et Adonai haleluyah. atu ribbi chizkiyya veribbi yesa, venashku resheh, amru uma kol kach hava immach vela yedana, zakkaa hay shaata dearana bach.
1346: Tu amar, vechi al da bilchodoy tavva shelomo, veha baatar achara amar kegavvna da, patach veamar, (Kohelet 9:3) ze ra bechol asher naasa tachat hashshemesh. ze ra vadday. may ze ra. da hu man deoshid zara berekanayya, vechavil orchoy, begin dehay lav madoreh bekudesha berich hu, vela yehe leh chulaka bealma deate. hada hu dichtiv, (Tehillim Adonai:Adonai) ki lo el chafetz resha atta lo yegurecha ra. al da amar, ze ra, dela yehe leh madora leella. ki mikre echad lakkol vegam lev bene haadam male ra (begin da) veholelot bilvavam. bechayyehem shettuta takia belibbayyhu, veinnun mechusere mehemnuta, velet lon chulaka bekudesha berich hu, uveinnun bene mehemnuta, lav bealma den, vela bealma deate, hada hu dichtiv, (Kohelet 9:3) veacharav el hammetim.

Ta chaze, kudesha berich hu azhar livne alma veamar, (Devarim 30:19) uvacharta bachayyim lemaan tichye, (behay alma, uvealma deate) vechayyin dehahu alma ninhu. innun chayyayvin mechusere mehemnuta may ka amre. (Kohelet 9) ki mi asher yivchar vegomer. af al gav deyivchar bar nash behay alma (sefer acher behahu alma) kema deamar, lav hu kelum, deha mesira da bidana, (Kohelet 9:4) el kol hachayyim yesh bittachon, umesira da bidayyhu, (Kohelet 9:4) ki lechelev chay hu tov min haarye hammet. hech yehe lan chayyin behahu alma. veal da ze ra vday, dela yedurun bemalka illaa, vela yehe lon chulaka beh. veaf al gav dechol hane kerae tishkach semichin lechavrayyay bemillin acharanin, aval vadday shelomo ka ata legallaa al innun chayyayvin mechusere mehemnuta, delet lon chulaka bekudesha berich hu bealma den uvealma deate.

Amar leh, tive denitchabbar bahadach vetezil bahadan. amar lehu, i avidna hachi, orayyta yikre alay kesil, velo od ella deitchayayvna benafshay. amru leh lamma. amar lon deha shelicha ana, veshadru li bishlichuta, ushelomo malka amar, (Mishlei 26:6) mekatztze raglayim chamas shote sholeach devarim beyad kesil. ta chaze, meraggelim al dela ishtechachu bene mehemnuta usheluche mehemnuta, itchayayvu benafshayyhu bealma den uvealma deate. nashak lon, veazal leh.

Azlu ribbi chizkiyya veribbi yesa, ad dahavo azlu pagu beinnun bene nasha. shailu ribbi chizkiyya veribbi yesa aleh, amru ma shemeh dehahu bar nash. amru, ribbi chaggay hu, vechavra deven chavrayyay hu, veshadru leh chavrayyay devavel, leminda millin meribbi shimon ben yochay ushear chavrayyay. amar ribbi yesa, vday da hu ribbi chaggay, dechol yomoy la baa leachazaa garmeh bema deyada, veal da amar lan deha bereh zacha leh beorayyta, begin deamar kera, (Mishlei 26:12-13) raita ish chacham beenav tikkeva lichsil mimmennu. vadday shelicha mehemana ihu, (vezakkaa hu shelicha mehemana) vezakkaa ihu man deshadar milloy bida dishlicha mehemana.

Ta chaze, eliezer eved avraham mibbene kenaan hava, kema deat amer, (Hoshea 12:8) kenaan beyado mozne mirma. uchenaan ketiv aleh, (Bereshit 9:25) arur kenaan eved avadim yihye leechav. uvegin dehava shelicha mehemana, ma ketiv beh. (Bereshit 24:27) bo beruch Adonai. beruch Adonai mammash. veal da achtiv hachi beorayyta, begin denafak mehahi kelala, veitberach. vela day leh denafik minnah, ella deitberach bishmeh dekudesha berich hu. veolifna deata malach, veail milla da befumeh delavan.

Vayishlach otam moshe vegomer, kullam anashim. kullehu zakkain havo, vereshe deyisrael havo. aval innun dibberu legarmayyhu eta bisha. amay natle eta da. ella amru, i yealun yisrael leara, nitavar anan millemehevi reshin, veyimne moshe reshin acharanin, deha anan zachenan bemadbera lemehevi reshin, aval beara la nizke. veal denatle eta bisha legarmayyhu, mitu innun, vechol innun denatlan millayyhu.
1347: Elle shemot haanashim asher shalach moshe vegomer, amar ribbi yitzchak, moshe istakkal veyada dela yitzlechun bearchayyhu, keden tzalle aleh dihoshua. keden kalev hava bedochaka, amar, ma abid, ha yehoshua azil besiyayta illaa demoshe, deshadar beh nehiru desihara, vehu anhir aleh bitzloteh, begin deihu shimsha. ma avad kalev. ishtemit minnayyhu, veate legabbe kivrayyay daavahan, vetzalle tamman tzeloteh.

Amar ribbi yehuda, orach achara natil, veakim shevilin, umata al kivre daavahan, veistakkan begarmeh, deha ketiv vesham achiman sheshay vetalmay yelide haanak. aval man deihu bedochaka, la istakkal midi. kach kalev, begin dehava bedochaka, la istakkal midi, veata letzallaa al kivre avahan, leishtezava meeta da.

(Bamidbar 13:16) vayyikra moshe lehoshea bin nun yehoshua. ribbi yitzchak amar, vechi hoshea keraeh kera, veha ketiv (Shemot 17:9) vayyomer moshe el yehoshua. (Shemot 33:12) vihoshua bin nun naar. (Shemot 17:13) vayyachalosh yehoshua. ella amar leh moshe, yah yoshiacha minnayyhu.

Ribbi abba amar, kevan deshadreh lemeal letaman, itzterich lemehevi shelim. uvemma. bishchinta. dead hahi shaata naar ikre, kema deokimna. uvehahi shaata kashir leh moshe bahadah, veaf al gav deashkechan yehoshua bekadmita, kera karyeh hachi al hahu dezammin lemikreyeh. amar moshe, vadday la itzterich da lemeal tamman, ella bishchinta, vehachi itchaze.

(Bamidbar 13:20) hayesh bah etz im ayin vegomer, ribbi chiyyay amar, vechi la hava yada moshe deit bah kama ilanin meshanyayn da min da, veha hu shibbach lah leyisrael bechamma zimnin, vehu istappak beda. veha kudesha berich hu kaamar leh lemoshe bekadmita, dehi eretz zavat chalav udevash. amar ribbi yose, ha attearu chavrayyay, dichtiv, (Iyov 1:1) ish haya veeretz utz iyyov shemo.

Amar ribbi shimon, ramaz lahem remiza dechachmeta, al ma deshailu bekadmita. dichtiv, (Shemot 17:7) hayesh Adonai bekirbenu im ayin. amar, tamman, techemun, i hi itchazya lehay, o lehay. amar lon, i techemun deiva deara kishar are dealma, yesh bah etz ilana dechayye, vela meatar illaa yattir. vei techemun deiva deara yattir umeshanyay mikkol atar dealma, tindeun, deha meattika kaddisha ka nagid veitmeshach hahu shinuyay illaa, mikkol atre dealma. uveda tindeun, hayesh bah etz, im ayin, veda baitun bekadmita (dabemaaykevan baaytevan) leminda da, dichtiv, (Shemot 17:7) hayesh Adonai bekirbenu. bekirbenu dayyka, o im ayin. veal da vehitchazzaktem ulekachtem mipperi haaretz, leminda shinnuyay dileh.

Vehayyamim yeme bikkure anavim. vehayyamim, may ka mayyre, deha veaz bikkure anavim saggi leh. ella vehayyamim, innun deishtemodan, kullehu havo mitchabberan behahu zimna behahu ilana dechata beh adam harishon. kema detanenan anavim hayu veal da, vehayyamim: innun deishtemodan, yeme bikkure anavim dayyka.

(Bamidbar 13:22) vayyaalu vannegev vayavo ad chevron. vayavou mibbae leh. ella amar ribbi yose, kalev hu deata letzallaa al kivre avahata. amar kalev, yehoshua ha barche moshe besiua illaa kaddisha, veyachil leishtezava minnayyhu, vaana ma abid. imlach, lemibbae bauta al kivre avahata, begin deyishteziv merazehon (sefer acher maaytea bisha) dishar meallin.

Ribbi yitzchak amar, man dehava rashim mikkullehu da al begavvivy deveh talya kolla. veta chaze, man hu mishshear ochori deyechul leaala tamman, deha ketiv vesham achiman sheshay vetalmay, umiddechilu dilhon man yachil lealaa
1348: Bimarta. ella shechinta alat tamman bechalev, levassera laavahan, deha mata zimna leaala benayyhu leara, deome lon kudesha berich hu, veda hu vayyavo ad chevron.

Tana, achiman sheshay vetalmay, mimman nafku. zara havo meinnun nefilin, deappil lon kudesha berich hu beara, veolidu mibbenat ara, uminnayyhu nafku gibbare alma, kema dichtiv, (Bereshit 6:4) hemma haggibborim asher meolam anshe hashshem. asher meolam, shammashe (nusach acher madeatebarey) alma mishtakkeche. anshe hashshem achiman sheshay vetalmay.

(Bamidbar 13:23) vayavou ad nachal eshkol vegomer, ribbi yehuda patach, (Yeshayahu 42:5) ko amar hael Adonai bore hashshamayim venotehem vegomer. kamma it lehu livne nasha leistakkela befulechana dekudesha berich hu, kamma it lehu leistakkela bemille deorayyta, dechol man deishtedal beorayyta, keillu mekarev kol korbenin dealma lekamme kudesha berich hu. vela od ella dekudesha berich hu mechapper leh al kol chovoy, umetaknin leh kama kuresyayn lealma deate, (chaser).

Ribbi yehuda hava azil bearcha bahade ribbi abba, shaal leh, amar milla chad baena leshaala, kevan deyada kudesha berich hu dezammin bar nash lemechete kammeh, ulemigzar aleh mita, amay bara leh. deha orayyta hava tere alfin shenin ad la ivre alma. uchetiv bah beorayyta, (Bamidbar 19:14) adam ki yamut beohel. (Bamidbar 27:8) ish ki yamut. vayyamat. vaychi peloni vayyamat. may kavae kudesha berich hu lebar nash behay alma, deafillu i ishtaddal beorayyta yemama velelya yemut, vei la ishtaddal beorayyta yemut, kolla bechad archa, bar perishuta dehahu alma, kema deat amer (Kohelet 9:2) kattov kachote.

Amar leh, orchoy demarach, vegazre demarach, ma lach lemitrach behu. ma deit lach reshu leminda uleistakkela shail, udelet lach reshu leminda, ketiv (Kohelet Adonai:Adonai) al titten et picha lachati et besarecha, deorchoy dekudesha berich hu vesitrin, genizin illain, dehu satim veganiz let lan leshaala. amar leh, i hachi, ha orayyta kolla satim veganiz, deha hi shema kaddisha illaa havi, uman demitasak beorayyta keillu itasak bishmeh kaddisha, vei hachi, let lan leshaala uleistakkela.

Amar leh orayyta kolla satim vegalyay, ushemeh kaddisha satim vegalyay, uchetiv (Devarim 29:28) hannistarot laAdonai elohenu vehanniglot lanu ulevanenu, hanniglot lanu, deit reshu leshaala, uleayyeyna uleistakkela behu uleminda behu. aval hannistarot laAdonai elohenu, dileh innun, veleh itchazyayn, deman yachil leminda uleitdabbeka datoy setima, vekol shekken lemishal.

Ta chaze, let reshu livne alma lememar millin setimin ulefarsha lon, bar butzina kaddisha rabbi shimon, deha kudesha berich hu istakkam al yedoy. uvegin dedara dileh reshima hu leella vetatta, veal da millin ittemaru beitgalyay al yedoy, vela yehe dara kedara da deihu share begavih, ad deyete malka meshicha.

Aval ta chaze, ketiv (Bereshit 1:27) vayyivra elohim et haadam betzalmo betzelem elohim bara oto (becholla hu keen dugema deella ta chaze) raza demilla, telat almin it leh lekudesha berich hu, deihu ganiz begavavyyhu. alma kadmaa, hahu illaa temira decholla, dela istakkal beh, vela ityeda beh, bar ihu, deihu ganiz begavvivy.
Alma tinyayna, deihu kashir behahu dilella, veda hu dekudesha berich hu ishtemoda minneh, kema dichtiv (Tehillim 118:19) pitchu li shaare tzedek, ze hashshaar laAdonai. veda hu alma tinyayna.

Alma telitaa, hahu alma tattaa minnayyhu, deishtechach beh piruda, veda hu alma, demalache illae sharyayn begavvivy, vekudesha berich hu ishtechach beh, vela ishtechach. ishtechach beh hasheta, kad baan leistakkela uleminda leh, istallak minnayyhu, vela itchaze, ad dechullehu shaale ayye mekom kevodo. (Yechezkel 3:12) baruch kevod Adonai mimmekomo. vehay hu alma dela ishtechach beh tedira.
Kegavvna da, (Bereshit 9:6) betzelem elohim asa et haadam. keden it
1349: Leh telat almin. alma kadmaa: hay alma deikre alma defiruda, ubbar nash ishtechach beh vela ishtechach. kad baan leistakkela beh, istallak minnayyhu vela itchaze.
Alma tinyayna, alma deihu kashir behahu alma illaa, veda hu gan eden di beara, deda hu kashir bealma achara illaa, umehay ityeda veishtemoda alma achara.

Alma telitaa, alma illaa temira, ganiz vesatim, delet man deyeda leh, kema dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 64:3) ayin lo raata elohim zulatcha yaase limchakke lo. vecholla kegavvna illaa, (kadmaa daamena vabekashevat) dichtiv, (Bereshit 9:6) betzelem elohim asa et haadam.

(401 Chaze vadday) al da ketiv, (Devarim 14:1) banim attem laAdonai elohechem vegomer, kema deukemuha. veillen innun betzelem elohim, veillen yartin yeruta illaa kegavvna dileh. veal da azhar beorayyta, (Devarim 14:1) lo titgoddu velo tashimu karcha. deha la itavid, veha shechiach bealmin tavin illain veyakkirin, lehevon chaddan kad istalak (tzadika) mehay alma.

Veta chaze, ilmale la chav adam, la yitam taama demota behay alma, bezimna deayil lealmin acharanin. aval begin dechav, taam taama demota, ad la yeul leinnun almin, veitpashshat rucha mehay gufa, veashar leh behay alma, verucha istachya binhar dinur lekabbela onsha. ulevatar ayyla legan eden divara, veizdammena leh mana achara dinhora, kehay partzufa degufa dehay alma mammash. veitlabbash veittakkan beh. vetamman hu madora dileh tadir. veitkeshar beresh yarche veshabbatte benishmeta. vesalik veitattar leella leella, hada hu dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 66:23) vehaya midde chodesh bechadsho vegomer.

Midde chodesh bechadsho amay. ella raza demilla, begin chadtute desihara, deitattera (ateravey) leanhara min shimsha behahu zimna. vechen midde shabbat beshabbatto, midde shabbat da sihara. beshabbatto da shimsha. dinhora atya lah min tamman. veal da kolla chad milla. veda hu berira demilla, bar lechayyayvayya dichtiv behu mita lechullehu almin, karet mikkullehu almin. veishtatzyayn mikkolla, kad la ayyle bitshuva. amar ribbi yehuda, berich rachamana, deshailna veravavchna millin illen, vekaimna alayyhu.

Amar ribbi shimon, mipparsheta da olifna raza dechachmeta, veishtemau minnah razin illain veyakkirin. ta chaze, kudesha berich hu meshabbach beorayyta, veamar azilu veorchay, ishtadlu befulechanay, veha ana meayil lechon lealmin tavin, lealmin illain. bene nasha dela yade, la mehemne, vela mistakkele, kudesha berich hu amar, azilu alilu hahu alma tava, hahu alma illaa dechissufa. innun amre, ech nechul lealla leh, uleminda kol hay.

Ma ketiv. alu ze vannegev, ishtedalu beorayyta, vetechomun deha hi kayyeyma kamayyeychu, uminah tindeun leh. (Bamidbar 13:18) ureitem et haaretz ma hi vegomer. techomun minnah hahu alma, deha yeruta deachasana, daana ayel lechu ba. veet haam hayyoshev aleha, innun tzaddikayyay divginta deeden, dekayyman shurin shurin bikara illaa, bedargin illain.

Hechazak hu harafe, bah techomu i zachu lechol hay kad attekafu al yitzrehon, vetavru leh, i la. o kad attekafu beorayyta, lemile bah yemama velelya. o i arpu yedayyhu minnah. vezachu lechol hay. hameat hu im rav, i saggiin innun deishtaddalu befulechani, veattekifu beorayyta, begin dezachu lechol hay i la.

(Bamidbar 13:20) uma haaretz hashshemena hi im raza. middeorayyta tindeun ma haaretz. ma hahu alma i asge tivu illaa leyatvaha, o i azir minne kelum. hayesh bah etz im ayin, hait bah ilana dechayye, lealam ulealme almin, o i tzerora dechayye ishtechach begavvav, im la.
1350: (Bamidbar 13:22) vayyaalu vannegev vayyavo ad chevron. vayyaalu vannegev, bene nasha sallekin begavvav vannegev, belibba atzla, keman deishtedal bemaggana, bingivu, dechashiv delet bah agar, chame deha utera dehay alma avid beginah, chashiv decholla hu. vannegev: kema deat amer (Bereshit 8:13) charvu hammayim, umetargeminan negivu.

Levatar vayyavo ad chevron, ad deate leitchabbera bah, kare veshane ba. (Bamidbar 13:22) vesham achiman sheshay vetalmay, tamman chame peliggan saggiin, tame vetahor, asur umuttar, (nusach acher kasher ufasul) onashin veaggarin. illen innun arche deorayyta, dikduke orayyta. yelide haanak, deityelidu missitra digvura.

Vechevron sheva shanim nivneta, illen innun shivin anpin deorayyta, shivin panim it lah, lechol sitra asra. vechevron, da orayyta, man deishtedal bah ikre chaver. lifne tzoan mitzrayim, tanenan orayyta it lokovel orayyta. vehayeynu tora shebbichtav, vetora shebbeal pe. vehay (malchut) chevron. mittora shebbichtav nafkat. kema deat amer (Mishlei 7:4) emor lachachma achoti at. vehay nivneta sheva shenin, debgin kach ikre bat sheva. lifne tzoan mitzrayim, kema deat amer (Melachim 1 Adonai:10) vatterev chachmat shelomo mechachmat kol bene kedem umikkol chachmat mitzrayim.

(Bamidbar 13:23) vayavou ad nachal eshkol, illen innun mille aggada, derasha, detalyayn missitra dimhemnuta. vayichretu mishsham zemora vegomer, olfin mittamman rashe pirkin, rashe millin, innun divne mehemnuta, chaddan bemillin, umitbarchan millin begavayyhu, umistakkelan sharsha chad veikara chad, vela ishtechach behu piruda. innun dela mishtakkeche bene mehemnuta, vela olfe orayyta lishmah, shavyan leh limhemnuta befiruda, hada hu dichtiv vayyissauhu vammot bishnayim, befiruda. mahu vammot. kema deat amer (Tehillim 121:3) al yitten lammot raglecha. umin harimmonim umin hatteenim, kolla shavin lehane mile lesitra achara, lesitra deminae, lesitra defiruda.

Hada hu dichtiv vayyashuvu mittur haaretz. vayyashuvu, tayyvin lesitra bisha, vetayyvin mearcha dikshot. amre, may ichpat lan. ad yoma la chamena tav lealma, amalna bah, beta rekam. yativna biklana deamma, ulehahu alma man yizke uman yeul legavvivy, tav lan dela atrachna kule hay. (Bamidbar 13:27) vaysapperu lo vayyomru vegomer, ha amalna velaena, begin leminda chulaka dehahu alma. vegam zavat chalav udevash hi, tav hu hahu alma illaa, kema deyadana beorayyta, aval man yechil lemizke beh.

(Bamidbar 13:28) efes ki az haam, takkif hu, dela yachashiv kol alma kelal, begin diyhe leh utera sagi leishtaddela beh, man hu deyizke bah. vadday efes ki az haam hayyoshev baaretz, man devae lemizke bah, bae lemehevi takkif beutera, kema deat amer (Mishlei 18:23) veashir yaane azzut. vehearim gedolot betzurot. battin malyayn kol tuva, dela yachserun mikkolla. veim kol da vegam yelide haanak rainu sham, bae gufa takkif, gibbor kaari. (deishtechach tamman tedira) begin dehi matteshet cheleh debar nash leishtaddela behahu isur vehetter, tame vetahor, kasher ufasul. man yechul lezakkaa bah.

Veod, (Bamidbar 13:29) amalek yoshev beeretz hannegev. i yemma bar nash, deafillu bechol da yizke. amalek yoshev beeretz hannegev, ha yitzra bisha, kategora, mekatrega devar nash, deyishtechach tadir begufa. vehachitti vehaemori vegomer, kama mekatrege mishtakkeche tamman. dela yachil bar nash lemeal behahu alma kelal, man yizke leh, uman yeul begavih, bemillin illen, (Bamidbar 32:9) vayyaniu et lev bene yisrael. begin deappiku shum bish alah, kema deat amer vayyotziu et dibbat haaretz.

Innun bene mehemnuta may ka amre, im chafetz banu Adonai unetana lanu. kevan deyishtaddal bar nash biruta delibba legabbe kudesha berich hu, la bae minan ella libba, veyistamrun hahu reshima kaddisha, dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 60:21) veammech kullam tzaddikim leolam yirshu aretz.
1351: (Bamidbar 14:9) ach baAdonai al timrodu, bae dela yimredun beorayyta, deorayyta la bae utera, vela mane dechaspa vedahava. veattem al tiru et am haaretz, deha gufa tevira, i yishtedal beorayyta, yishkach asvavta becholla. hada hu dichtiv, (Mishlei 3:8) rifut tehi lesharecha veshikkuy leatzmotecha. uchetiv (Mishlei 4:22-23) ulechol besaro marpe. vechol innun mekatrege, innun machrezan veamre, panu atar liflanyyay avda demalka.

Begin kach al tiru, ki lachmenu hem, innun begarmayyhu mezammenan mezone bechol yoma leinnun demishtaddele beorayyta. kema deat amer (Melachim 1 17:4) veet haorvim tzivviti lechalkelcha. uchetiv (Melachim 1 17:6) vehaorvim meviim lo lechem uvasar. sar tzillam mealehem. man tzillam. da tukepa dedina kashya. may taama ade. mishshum dAdonai ittanu al tiraum. kolla adiu begin orayyta. zakkaa chulakehon deinnun demishtaddele beorayyta lishmah, deha mitkashshere bekudesha berich hu mammash. veikrun achim vereim. hada hu dichtiv, (Tehillim 122:8) lemaan achay vereay adabbera na shalom bach.

(Bamidbar 13:23) vayavou ad nachal eshkol vegomer. ribbi abba amar, kartu hahu eshkol, atu lesalleka leh la yachilu. atu lenatla leh, la yachilu. atu kalev vihoshua, natlu leh, useliku leh, veizdekaf al yedayyhu. hada hu dichtiv vayyissauhu vammot bishnayim. bishnayim beinnun shenayim yechidan. zemora may ka baan. ella eshkol hava talyay beh, uveod dehava mitchabbar beatreh, ikre zemora. levatar karye mot, dichtiv vayyissauhu vammot. hahu deishtemoda. hahu dechartu.

Mikkan yadu yehoshua vechalev, deinnun itchazyayn lemeal leara, ulemehevi lon bah chulak veachasana. ad dahavo atyayn amlechu alayyhu kullehu, kaim kalev beibba, amar ibba ibba, i beginach anan mitkatlin, ma anan bechulakach. miyyad kalil garmeh. veyahavu lon.

Ribbi elazar amar, la yahavu leochori, deha ketiv vayyissauhu vammot, uchetiv bishnayim, uvechullehu la havo shenayim kevavtayyhu. umikkan olif yehoshua levatar, dichtiv, (Yehoshua 2:1) vayishlach yehoshua bin nun min hashittim shenayim anashim meraggelim. vehane shenayim ha ukemuha kadmae. vechad matu legabbayyhu deyisrael, yahavu lon, veinnun ishtaaru, veavdu garmayyhu shirayim.

Ribbi yitzchak amar, kad havo matan legabbayyhu deinnun anakim, havo shavvyayn hahu chutera demoshe kammayyhu, veishtezivu. umenalan dehahu chutera yahiv lon. hada hu dichtiv, vayyomer alehem alu ze vannegev. ketiv hacha alu ze, uchetiv hatam (Shemot 4) veet hammatte hazze vegomer, uvegineh ishtezivu. dei tema hane anakayyay shavke lon. ella atu lenasba lon, vahavu shavvyayn lekamayyhu hahu chutera, umishtezve (sefer acher vameshatematey) mikkammayyhu. ribbi yehuda amar, masoret shema kaddisha masar lon moshe, uvegineh ishtezivu minnayyhu.

Ribbi chiyyay amar, telat shemahan ikrun, nefilim. anakim. refaim. vechullehu orche yome. nefilin ikrun bekadmita, levatar kad itchabberun bivnat bene nasha, veolidu minnayyhu, ikrun anakim. levatar dahavo azle veshatan behay alma, umitrafyayn mehahu dilella, ikrun refaim.

Amar ribbi yehuda, veha ketiv (Iyov 26:5) harfaim yecholalu, (Devarim 2:11) refaim yechashvu af hem kaanakim. amar leh, hachi hu, begin daanakim atu mehay sitra umehay sitra, veityaashu yattir beara. kegavvna da refaim, uminnayyhu nafke, vahavu orche yome. vechad mitchalleshe itchalash palgut gufa, ufalgut kaim. kevavn defalgut gufa hava mit, havo nasbe isba meisbe bara veshadyayn lefumayyhu, umitu. uvegin deinnun vaan lekatla garmayyhu, ikrun refaim. amar ribbi yitzchak, shadyayn garmayyhu beyamma rabba, vetavan umetin. hada hu dichtiv, (Iyov 26:5) harfaim yecholalu mittachat mayim veshochnehem.
Ribbi shimon amar, ilmale havo ayylin yisrael leara, besimana (nusach acher baavamenaa)
1352: Delishana bisha, la hava kaim alma riga chad. man umana delishana bisha, nachash. veraza demilla, middeata nachash al chavva attil bah zuhama. amar ribbi shimon, veal kolla machal kudesha berich hu, bar min lishana bisha. begin dichtiv, (Tehillim 12:5) asher amru lilshonenu nagbir sefatenu ittanu mi adon lanu.

Ta chaze, kamma aved hahu lishana bisha, gazar al avhatana dela yeul leara umitu innun deamru. veitgezar bichya ledare darin. (kol shekken hacha deappiku lishana bisha al kolla) kivyachol kevan deappiku al ara kaddisha, keillu appiku aleh. begin kach kanne kudesha berich hu al da, (kelomar kinne lishmeh) vekaimu yisrael kullehu leishtetzaa mealma, ilmale bauteh demoshe.

(Bamidbar 13:27) vaysapperu lo vayyomru vegomer. amar ribbi chiyyay, may shena hacha vaysapperu, vela ketiv vayyaggidu, o vayyomru. ella kol chad olif milla bilchodoy. vayyaggidu, bechol atar remez ka ramiz bechachmeta, veha ittemar. vayyomer, amira bealma. vayyomru, hirhura delibba. vayyomru, tafkidta. veha okimna bechamma atar. vaysapperu, perishuta demilla bechol atar.

Banu el haaretz, halachnu mibbae leh. ella banu, alana letaman lehahi ara dahavit meshabbach bechol yoma, vahavit amart delet dichvavta. vegam zavat chalav udevash hi. ribbi yitzchak amar, man devae lememar kediva, amar milla dikshot bekadmita, begin diyyehemnu leh kedivoy.

Ribbi chiyyay amar, (ella) hachi amru, alana lehahi ara dahavit meshabbach lah kol yoma veamarat delet dichvavta, (vegam zavat chelev udevash hi), vaarimat shevacha al kolla. velav hachi, deha ze pirya, atkela chad meinnun zeirin katfu. amru, i leda achasin kudesha berich hu leyisrael, vesavlu kol innun aktin veleutin, ha beara demitzrayim it atkelin veevin deara yattir, al chad teren.

(Bamidbar 13:28) efes ki az haam, orcheh dealma deinnun gibbarin maggiche kerava yatvin levar, leistammera archin. vehacha afilu innun bene mata, takkifin gibborin. vehearim betzurot, deafillu kol malchin dealma yitkanneshu alayyhu. la yaavdun behu pegimuta. amar ribbi yose, kol ma deamre, belishana bisha amru, vekashya mekullehu, dichtiv amalek yoshev beeretz hannegev. levar nash dinshacheh chivya, kad baan leagzema leh, amre ha chivya hacha.

Ribbi abba amar, vday da kashya mikkol ma deamre, kelomar, hahu deaggach kerava becholla, ha hacha zammin. uvean atar. beeretz hannegev, deha hu atar lealaa beh. miyyad vattissa kol haeda vayyittenu et kolam. keviu bichya laddorot, lealmin, behahu lelya.

Amar ribbi yose, eta nasivu al kolla, leappaka shum bish. may al kolla. al ara, veal kudesha berich hu. amar ribbi yitzchak, al ara tinach. al kudesha berich hu minayin. amar leh mashma dichtiv, efes ki az haam. man yachil behu. ki az haam dayyka. uchetiv amalek yoshev beeretz hannegev, keden garmu kol hay, kema deittemar. uvaa kudesha berich hu leshetzaa lon min alma, hada hu dichtiv, (Tehillim 106:23) vayyomer lehashemidam lule moshe vechiro amad bapperetz lefanav vegomer.

(Bamidbar 14:17) veatta yigdal na koach Adonai. ribbi acha veribbi yose amre, zakkay innun yisrael meammin ovde kochavim umazzalot dealma. dekudesha berich hu itree behu, veitkene behu, veitpaar behu, deha alma la ivre ella beginehon deyisrael, deyishtaddelun beorayyta, begin dechad bechad itkashran. veyisrael letatta behay alma, innun kiyyuma dileh, vekiyyuma dechol shear ammin, ematay bizman deavde reuta demarehon.

Ta chaze, kad bara kudesha berich hu bar nash bealma, atkin leh kegavvna illaa (yakkira), veyahav leh cheleh vetukepeh beemtzaita degufa, detamman sharya libba. dehu (mezona) tukepa dechol gufa, umittamman ittezan kol gufa. (vechol inun shayyfe degufa mittamman ittezanu) veha libba achid
1353: Veittakaf baatar illaa dilella. deihu mocha deresha, deshari leella (veachid beh), veda itkeshar beda.

Uvegavvna deda, atkin kudesha berich hu alma. veavad (leh) chad gufa, veatkin shayyfe degufa sacharaneh delibba, velibba share beemtzaita dechol gufa. vechol innun shayyfin ittezanu mehahu libba, dehu tukepa decholla, vecholla beh talyayn. vehahu libba, itkeshar veitachad bemocha illaa desharya leella.

Ta chaze, kad bara kudesha berich hu alma, ashra (sefer acher asdar) leyamma deokyanus deaschar kol yishshuva dealma. veyishshuva dechol shivin umin kolla aschar liyrushalam. viyrushalam beemtzaita dechol yishshuva sharya. vehi aschara lehar habbayit. vehar habbayit aschar laazarot deyisrael. veinnun azarot sacharan lelishkat haggazit, detamman sanheddere gedola yatvin. vetanenan, let yeshiva baazara, ella lemalche bet david bilchodayyhu.

Velishkat haggazit aschar lammizbeach. vehammizbeach aschar levet haulam. vehaulam lahechol. vehechol levet kodesh hakodashim, detamman shechina sharya, vechapporet ucheruvim vearon. vehacha hu libba, dechol ara vealma. umehacha ittezanu kol innun atre deyishshuva, deinnun shayyfi degufa. velibba da ittezan mimmocha deresha, veitachid da beda, hada hu dichtiv (Shemot 15:17) machon leshivtecha paalta Adonai. kegavvna da leella leella, veihu beraza demalka illaa, beraza yakkira setimaa.

Yamma illaa lokovel da. deit yamma leella min yamma, veyamma min yamma. ta chaze, nehar dinur aschar lechamma mashiryayn. mikovleh shivin sitrin, gelifin mishshiva delikin, veinnun sacharan, leinnun shammashe dilgo minnayyhu. veinnun sacharin learba retichin. veinnun sacharan lehahi karta dekaddisha dirvia alayyhu.

Vetana, tamman azarot lego meazarot. velet yeshiva baazara detamman, ella lemalkehon devet david bilchodayyhu, vetamman mishtachche veyatve. vesahnedre gedola, mishtakkeche tamman belishkat haggazit. vehahu be dina alayyhu, dimshammesh laatar dimshammesh. vedina ityehiv mittamman, lekaddishin elyonin, ad demata laatar deikre kodesh hakodashim, deveh kolla, vetamman hu libba sharyay, veda ittezan min mocha dilella, veitachid da beda.

Kegavvna da leella leella, veihu beraza demalka illaa, beraza yakkira setimaa. ad deishtechach, decholla ittezan mimmocha illaa, setimaa decholla. vechad yistakkelun mille, kolla itkeshar da beda veda beda.

Ta chaze, kad anhir attika setima bemocha, umocha anhir lelibba, bederech noam Adonai. veha okimna, veda hu koach Adonai. hahu chela deate meattika kaddisha. setima dechol setimin. yigdal na, deyyitrebe veyisge leella leella. veyitnegid veyitmeshach letatta. kaasher dibbarta, kema deukemuha. lemor, lemelaf mehacha kol darin batrain, lealam ulealme almin. lemor, lememar leda beshaata deakta. lememar da, beshaata dirvavcha. umay hu. Adonai erech appayim vegomer, veha okimna mille.

Amar ribbi yitzchak, emet amay salik mikkan. amar ribbi chiyyay, innun garmu leh deistalik mikkan, deha beshikru dibberu garmayyhu behahu midda debar nash moded bah, moddin leh. vechen shear ochore istelaku, dela yachil moshe lememrinhu, begin deinnun garmu. salachti kidvarecha, kidvarecha mammash, veha attearu chavrayyay, veha ittemar. (amar hamegayh kach matzati baheatekavet asher lifne umittoch hallashon nire shechaser hatechalat hammaamar vegam bimkomot acherim mimmennu chaser veim kol ze lo ratziti laheshameytev min hassefer lehagedil tora valehaadayr)

Da im da, ma dela havo yachlin lemallela mikkadmat dena. nafku mehahi pitcha, veyatvu beginta techot ilanin. amru da leda, kevan daanan hacha, vechamenan kol da, i nemut hacha, vadday neul lealma deate. yatvu. shenata naflat alayyhu. vedamchu. adhachi, ha hahu memana ata,
1354: Veatar lon, amar lon, kumu puku lego pardes deavra. nafku, chamu leillen mare mikra, dahavu amre behahu kera, (Bamidbar 14:35) bammidbar hazze yittammu, ha baatar achara la. vesham yamutu, ha baatar achara la, veda begufin, aval benishmatin la, kegavvna divne ginta.

Amar lon hahu memana, puku. nafku bahadeh, amar lon, shematun midi lego hahu darga. amru, shemana deha chad kala hava amar, man defasak, yitpesak. man dekatzar, yitkatzar. man dekatzar, yitarach. amar lon, yedatun may hay. amru, la. amar lon, chamittun hahu nishra ravreva, vehahu yenoka deka melakket asavin, ribbi ilai dintzivin hava. hu uvereh, umata hacha, vechama hu vinoka bereh mearta da, kevan dealu lego chashuch, la yachilu lemisbal, umitu.

Vehahu yenoka bereh, kayyeyma bechol yoma kammeh divtzalel, beshaata denachit mimmetivta illaa, veamar kammeh telat millin, ad la yiftach betzalel berazin setimin dechachmeta, dechol milloy razin setimin innun, (Yeshayahu 64:3) deayin lo raata elohim zulatcha. hay (man) deamar, man defasak yitpesak. man defasak millin deorayyta, al millin betelin, yitpaskun chayyohi mehay alma, vedine kayyeyma behahu alma. man dekatzar yitkatzar, man dekatzar amen, vela maarich beh go nayycha, yitketzar mechayyin dehay alma. man dekatzar yitarach, man deamar echad, itzterich lechattefa alef, ulekatztzera keria dile, vela yeakkev behay at kelal. uman deavid da, yitarchun chayav.

Amru leh, tu amar, teren innun, vachada ishtetaf behu, veinnun telata. vechad havo telata, innun chad. amar lon, illen teren shemahan dishma yisrael, deinnun Adonai Adonai. elohenu ishtetaf behu, veihu chotama degushepanka, emet. vechad mitchabberan kachada innun chad beyichuda chada.

Tu amar, teren innun vechad ithadar. kad shallit. tas al gadpe rucha, veshat bematan elef, veittammar. amar lon, illen teren keruvim, dehava rachiv behu kudesha berich hu. umin yoma deagniz yosef meachuy, agniz ihu (sefer acher chad), veishtear chad legabbe binyamin, hada hu dichtiv, (Tehillim 18:11) vayyirchav al keruv vayyaof vayede al kanfe ruach. veagniz bematan elef almin veittammar, hahu derachiv aleh, deinnun matan elef genizin, innun dileh, berich hu.

Puku mehacha, zakkain attun, nafku, yahav lon hahu memana vavrda (achara) chada venafku. kad nafku astim pum mearta, vela itchaze kelal. chamu hahu nishra, dehava nachit mehahu ilana, veaal go mearta achara. archu innun behahu vavrda, vealu tamman, ashkachu hahu nishra appum mearta, amar lon ulu zakkae keshot chavrin, deha la chamena chedva dechavruta, min yoma daana hacha, ella bechu.

Alu matu lappardes achara, vehahu nishra bahadayyhu, kad matu legabbe innun marehon demishna, ithaddar hahu nishra bediyyukena deadam, bilvush yekar, menahara kevavtayyhu, veyativ immehon kachada, amar leinnun deyatve, havu yekar lemare matnita deatu hacha, deha marehon achme lon pelian ravrevan hacha. amar chad minnayyhu, it bechu simana. amru hin. appiku teren veradin, vearchu behu. amru, tivu mare metivta, tivu zakkae keshot, achidu behu, veyatvu. behahi shaata, olfu tamman telatin halachot, dela havo yade mikkadmat dena, verazin acharanin deorayyta.

Ahadru legabbe innun mare mikra, ashkachu dahavo amre, (Tehillim 82:6) ani amarti elohim attem uvene elyon kulchem. ani amarti, beshaata deakdimtun asiyya lashshemia. deha elohim attem vegomer. kevan deamshichtun batar yetzer hera, achen keadam temutun vegomer. ma mitato shel adam achit leh leafra, begin deyitmeche hahu yetzer hara di begavvih, vehahu yetzer hara ihu demit, veitakkol begavvih.
1355: Amar hahu sava dealayyhu, uf hacha ketiv, ufigrechem attem yippelu bammidbar hazze. may pigrechem. da yetzer hara, kalil dechar venukeba. chesronin deit bechu, deyetzer hara nachit tadir lechesrona, vela salik. bakkodesh maalin vela moridin, bimsaavu moridin tadir, vela maalin. veal da ikrun pigrechem, chesronin dilchon. kema deat amer (Shmuel 1 30:10) asher piggeru meavor et hannachal vegomer, sofa dikra ochach, dichtiv yippelu, vela tippelu. veal da, bammidbar hazze yittammu innun pegarim vesham yamutu, begin diruta dekudesha berich hu leshetzaa lehane pegarim mealma, lealam.

Amar lehu ribbi ilai, zakkae keshot, ulu vetechemu, deha reshu itmesar lechu, lemeal ad hahu atar defarochta perisa. zakkaa chulakechon. kamu vealu go ducheta chada, vahavu tamman marehon deaggada, veanpehon menaharan kinhiru deshimsha. amru man illen. amar lehon, illen marehon deaggada. vechaman bechol yoma nehiru deorayyta kaddeka yeot. kayymu, ushemau kama millin chadtin beorayyta, vela ityehiv lon reshu lemeal legavayyhu.

Amar leh ribbi ilai, ulu leducheta achara vetechomu. alu lego ginta achara, vechamu uf hachi karan kivrin, umiyyad metin. umithadderin chayyin begufin menaharan kaddishin. amre leh, may hay. amar leh, da avde bechol yoma, umiyyad deshachve mitakkela hahu zuhama bisha dekabbilu bekadmita, vekayymin miyyad begufin chadtin menaharin, beinnun gufin kaddishin dekayyme al tura desinay, kegavvna deattun chaman, kayymu kullehu al tura desinay, begufin bela lichlucha kelal, kevan deamshichu alayyhu yetzer hara, ithadaru begufin acharanin, degufin kadmain, gufin nucherain, hada hu dichtiv, (Shemot 33:6) vayyitnatztzelu bene yisrael et edyam mehar chorev.

Kala ittear, zilu itkenashu, ha oholiav kaim al kiyyumeh, vechol innun kattedrain kammeh. leshaata parchu kullehu, vela chamu midi, ishtaaru bilchodayyhu techot ilanin deginta. chamu pitcha achara, alu tamman, chamu hechla chada, alu veyativu tamman. teren ulemin havo tamman. zakfu ayynin, vechamu chad mashkena merukkema bechol zine tziyyurin ugevavnin dealma, vealeh peres perisa dinhora menatztzetza, dela yachlin ayynin leistakkela (vakepaven teren millin chamu go hahu mashkena ad atar parochta perisa dela chamu), mittamman ulehala la chamu kelum.

Arkinu udenin, ushemau chad kala dehava amar, betzalel reviaa ihu linhorin illain. yosef reviaa ihu go nehorin deadam kadmaa. seliku dilella, chaviva decholla. aleh ketiv, (Bamidbar 28:5) venisko reviit hahin bakkodesh vegomer. man deyistakkal vechame, yismun eneh. man dela yistakkal, chame veitpetach. ilana detamne sere, kad kafif, yizkof veyitkeyyaym. i la kafif, chivya bisha achil leh. man deal teren keruvin lego, reuteh itavid. man dimayen, rachik meruteh. karbena deravya, shelim leitkabbela. pasak hahu kala.

Amru innun teren ulemin, simana it begavayychu. amru hin. appiku innun teren veradin, archu behu, amru tivu, ad detishmeun teren millin, berazin attikin, miggo mare metivta, vihon tadir beraza begavvayychu. amru hen.

Amar ribbi shimon, kol hane millin, vechol ma dechamu, katvu. vechad matu hacha, hava ketiv (Tehillim 39:2) eshmera derachay mechato vilshoni. vaana shailna laavi abba, kama havo innun teren millin, veamar li chayyecha beri, innun teren millin, banu almin, vecharivu almin, man deishtammash behu.

Kevan deshamu illen teren millin, amru innun yenuke, puku puku, let lechu reshuta yattir lemishma. appik chad minnayyhu, tappuach echad, veyahav lon. veamar, archu beda, archu beh, venafku, umikkol dechamu la anshu kelum. nafku.
Ha memana achara, ata amar lon, chavrayyay, ribbi ilai shadarni lechu, torechu leh hacha appum mearta, vehu yete veyoda lechu millin illain dela yedatun. deihu tava miggo
1356: Metivta, dihe leh reshu legallaa lechu millin. nafku bahadeh veorichu appum mearta, vahavu mehaderin mille da leda, mikkol ma dechamu veolifu tamman.

Addehachi, ha ribbi ilai ata, nahir keshimsha. amar leh orayyta chadta shemata. amar lon vadday, ureshu yahavu li lememar lechu mille. itchabbera kachada appum mearta, veyatvu. amar lon zakkain attun, deachme lechon marechon kegavvna dealma deate, veha let lechu dechilu veemtanu, amru vadday ha itneshe minan archa divne nasha, utavvavha ihu al kol ma dachamenan behay tura.

Amar lon, chamittun illen turayya, kullehu rashe metivte leamma da divmadbera. vezachu hasheta, ma dela zachu kad havo bachayyin. veillen reshshe metivte, kullehu beresh yarche veshabbatte umoadayyay, mitkanneshe legabbe tura deaharon kahana, umitare legabbeh, vealin go metivta dileh, umitchaddeshan tamman, bedachyu detala kaddisha denachit al resheh, umeshach revu denagid aleh, veimmeh mitchaddeshan kullehu bechiddushin dirchimin demalka kaddisha, ad deikre hacha metivta dirchimuta.
Veihu natil bechol metivta, bitmiru dakik mitaffan kenishrin go metivta dinhora, veihi metivta demoshe, vechullehu kayyme levar, vela alin lego, bar aharon bilchodoy uchefum shaata ikrun bishma.

Velet man dechame leh lemoshe, deha hahu masve deanpoy, peres kameh. usheva anane yekar sacharaneh. aharon kaim go pargoda diltatta min moshe. ufargoda pasik, vela pasik begavvayyhu. vechol reshshe metivte, levar mipparochta defargoda da. vechol shear, levar meinnun ananin. uchefum chiddushe dinhiru deorayyta deitnahara, hachi menaharan innun ananin.

Veitkelishu bidkiku dinhora, ad deitchaze hahu masve, umiggo hahu masve, chaman nehora denahir yattir mikkol nehirin dealma. veinnun anpe moshe. anpoy la itchazun kelal, velet man dechame lon, bar hahu nehiru denafik miggo hahu masve, batar kol innun ananin.

Moshe amar milla setam leaharon, veaharon parish leravreve metivte. bema parish. bechol innun mabbuin deastimu minneh, kad mata zimneh dihoshua. vehashsheta ihu mehadar lon. bechamma pelian, umekorin umabbuin unechalin denavin mikkol milla umilla.

Kol nashin zachyayn dehay dara, atan lemiryam uf hacha behane zimnin. ucheden sallekin kullehu, ketimrot ashan go madbera da. vehahu yoma, ikre yoma dehillula. nashin belele shabbatot uvelele yomin tavin, kullehu atan legabbe miryam, veyadin ishtaddeluta bidia demare alma. zakkaa dara da, mikkol darin dealma. nafke mimmetivta demoshe, ufarche legabbe metivta dirkia, veinnun deitchazun parche legabbe metivta illaa. al hahu dara ketiv, (Tehillim 144:15) ashre haam shekkacha lo ashre haam sheAdonai elohav.

Patach ribbi ilai veamar, (Devarim 18:13) tamim tihye im Adonai elohecha. ma ben tam letamim. veavraham ketiv, (Bereshit 17:1) hithallech lefanay vehye tamim. yaakov deishtelim yattir, ketiv beh, (Bereshit 25:27) veyaakov ish tam. amay ikre ish tam. begin dela ishtear beh pesolet kelal, deha peria hava beh.

Bema itpera, (sefer acher feria hava beh deitpera) veitdakke mehahu pesolet begin dehahu atar deatkif lifsolet, dilgo atar difria share, ihu shor, diyyukena dismala dechursaya dileh. vehahu shor, ikre shor tam. deha reticha dechurseya, reshima divrit it beh. veal da, hay shor ikre tam. veyaakov achid beh begavvivy, uvehay shor avid peria, veabar zuhama difssolet kulla.

Bematnita divtzalel ketiv, (Bereshit 30:22) vayyizkor elohim et rachel. besara ketiv (Bereshit 21) pekida, uverachel ketiv zechira, amay. begin dezachor itreshim beyaakov, deihu berit shelim, kad (itavid) ityeylid yosef. uvemma. kad natal shor bahadeh, dela yatkif lesitra achara. uvegin kach, itkere yosef (Devarim 33:17) bechor shor, bechor dehahu shor
1357: Denatal yaakov bechor shoro, (vedache lehahu shor).

Vday, vehahu shor shor tam, veyaakov ish tam. ribbon veshalit, mareh deveta, dehahu shor tam share begavvivy. begin deit shor muad bistar arla peria. vechamma gardine nimusin nafkin minneh, ad darga batrayyta deikre sheiya. hahu deafil betin dealma, dela dayyrin behu bene nasha. vechullehu nafka mehahu shor muad. veda bechibbura dachamor bisha. uvegin kach (Devarim 22:10) lo tacharosh beshor uvachamor yachdav. begin dela leatteara lehu.

Uvehahu metivta divtzalel, vechen bitren metivta, veyaakov ish tam, balah dehahu tam. uman ihu 1 raza devav. vechad havo kelal dechar venukeba kachada, keden natil kol atvavn illen 441, veihu emet. (Micha 7:20) titten emet leyaakov, kelal dechar venukeba kachada, shelimu decholla.
Avraham la itpekad al peria, vechad al, al lehay tam, ulego dargin dileh, deikrun kachada yam. vehayeynu tamim. levatar istallak avraham, veal lego, veitkeshar im yemina illaa.

Tamim tihye im Adonai elohecha vadday, kema deihu tamim kelala chada, uf ant tehe immeh tamim, immeh vadday. bema itavid bar nash tamim, diyhe tam yam. tam kema deittemar. yam kol innun dargin kaddishin dileh ikrun yam, vela itparshan mineh lealmin. (tere navesachey) uf ant kegavvna da, leaadaa minach dargin nucherain, uleitkeshshera betamim, lemehevi bach dargin kaddishin, raza deyam, vedarga kaddisha, tam. lekabbela 1 raza deyaakov. bar nash itzterich lemehevi bechol yoma, tam yam. kegavvna da mammash.

Hasheta parish man defarish, bimtivta, desihara kaddisha shappira, ihu bechivvavru, vechol gavvnin menatztzan bah umerukkaman, veihu kehahu shepiru vechivvavru deshimsha mammash. uvehahu yamma dilah, go shivin shenin, nafka nuna chada, veappik minneh gon techelet, veihi natla gon da, vetakkinat leh, veitchappeyay levar behay gon. lav dehay gon levusha dilah, deha (Mishlei 31:22) shesh veargaman levushah. aval chuppaa dilvar hay gon hu. kegavvna da hava mashkena, dechuleh bishfiru merukkama lego, ulevatar (Bamidbar 4:6) ufarsu veged kelil techelet. may tama. begin ditchot yam da, it metzulot yam, kelal dechar venukeba, veit lon ena bisha leistakkela, vechad mistakkelin, zammin leenayyhu gon techela, vela yachla enayyhu leshalletaa, veihi ittekanat lego, bechol gevavnin merukkaman kaddeka yaut, mittachman led sitrin dealma.

Kegavvna da bar nash delavish tzitzit, itavid bechol yoma tamim. tam, bed kenafayim metukkenan kaddeka yaut. yam, behahu techelet denuna, deshivin dargin deyamma, sitra bisha kad istakkal behay bar nash la yachil leavasha leh beena bisha. ucheden ihu tam yam, im Adonai elohav mammash, betikkuna chada, ihi leella, veihu letatta.

Levatar istalakat ihi go dargin illain. uf hachi bar nash, istallak ihu levatar bitfilin, go dargin illain. veal da tamim tihye im Adonai elohecha, immeh vday. vadday beshaata chada, beriga chada, ihi ittaknat leella, ubbar nash ittakan letatta.

Amar ribbi ilai, kol illen dehacha, kegavvna da metakkenan, lemehevi kol chad tamim im Adonai. veal raza da, bammidbar hazze yittammu. i temrun dechad ittemar levish ittemar, hachi hu vadday, dehava lon lemehevi kol chad tamim im Adonai beara kaddisha, atar daAdonai share tamman, lemehevi appin beappin kachada immeh, vehasheta kol chad havi tamim bemadbera da levar, atar rachik mittamman, dela yistakkal anpin beanpin bahaddeh lemehevi im Adonai kaddeka yaut. vesham yamutu, kema dachamitun deavdin bechol yoma.

Zakkaa chulakchon chavrayyay kaddishin, dezachitun lechol hay. hane tere mearte acharanin dilchu, dela tishkechu kol da tamman, deinnun go metivta demoshe, yatve merachik. veal da ketiv bemoshe, (Bamidbar 12:3) anav meod mikkol
1358: Haadam. unevia illaa, kabbil lon limtivta dileh, miyyoma deshare lemecheme kol da, ad hahi shaata shiva yomin. veha la havo mistakkelin behay alma kelum.

Amar lon ribbi ilai, zakkain kaddishin, ema lechu millin dishmatun. umilla kadmaa kad tindeun medidu demishchata, bishma gelifa meforash, tindeun (veaf al gav) divtzalel reviaa ihu, dinhorin illain. dichtiv, (Shemot 31:3) vaamalle oto ruach elohim bechachma uvitvuna uvedaat. man dela istakkal chame veitpetach.

Man dela istakkal, beinnun telat millin temirin, ma leella, ma letatta vechulei. zammin ihu leitpattecha beorayyta, ulefakcha ayynin bah. ilana detamne sere, shidrato debar nash, kad kafif kamme mareh, yizkof veyitkeyyaym litchiyyayt metayyay. i la kafif bemodim, itavid chivya, velet leh tekuma lehahu zimna. man deal ben teren keruvim lego.

Man deal shiur teren pitchin, lego be kenishta, itdabbak bemareh, ureuteh itavid. man dimayen bitzloteh, veistakkal bah, rachik meruteh deshail. karbena deravya, kad karev bar nash bereh leve safra, o lemila, da karbena shelim leitkavla. mikkan ulehala rechimin, zilu. (chaser)

Elazar beri, shappir kaamart, kefum ma deolifat. aval chas veshalom, deaf al gav derachel havat akkara behahu zimna, yaakov chakkim hava. veilmale la yada yaakov, delea inteteh, la kavir lah bimarta, leitchabbera bahaddeh, bechibbura chada, vihe kavir lah levar meara. aval lelea ail lah go ara, ulerachel shavvi levar. mit yaakov, itkevar begavvav, bechibbura chada.

Kema deavdu kol shear avahan, uf hachi adam. meta chavva bekadmita, itkabberat tamman. vetamman yada adam, dehay ducheta itchaze leh. mit adam, itkevar begavvav bechibbura chada. meta sara itkabberat tamman, vechavva chamat, vechaddat lokovlah, vekamat vekabbala lah. shiura dechavva legabbe sara, shiura ditren ammin, vela yattir. met avraham, itkevar legabbe sara, bechibbura chada. meta rivka, itkabberat tamman, vesara chamat, vekamat vekibbelat lah. met yitzchak, itkevar bahadah bechibbura chada. meta lea, itkabberat tamman, verivka chamat, vekamat, vekabbala lah. met yaakov, itchabbar bahadah bechibbura chada. vechullehu dechar venukeba kachada, bechibbura chada.

Siddura dilhon hech shachne. nashin legabbe nashin, udechurin legabbe dechurin. adam beresha, chavva samich leh. sara legabbe chavva. avraham samich lesara. yitzchak samich leavraham. rivka samich leyitzchak. lea samich lerivka. yaakov samich lelea. ishtechach adam besitra da, yaakov besitra da, da resha, veda sefa.

Besifra dishlomo malka ihu kaddeka yaut vehachi hu, adam vechavva bekadmita. vesara veavraham samich lon. yitzchak verivka lezivya achara, beorach meshar beshura chada. yaakov velea beemtzaita. veinnun nashin legabbe nashin. udechurin legabbe dechurin. veadam vechavva, sara veavraham, yaakov velea, rivka veyitzchak. adam besitra da, veyitzchak besitra da, veyaakov beemtzaita. yitzchak legabbe avuha lav orach alma. veim kol da yaakov itzterich beemtzaita.

Uvechol innun zugin, kema deitkevaru, hachi yekumun, vehachi yishtakkechun. lea techede bahade mashiach, bereh dedavid, denafik minnah lego. rachel techede bahade mashiach, bereh deyosef, denafik minnah levar miyrushalam. vecholla leduchetayyhu.

Illen hacha veillen hacha. deinnun (sefer acher megaddelin) margelan deeven tava kullehu. ben kullehu migdalin it chad migdal deeven tava beemtzaita. veda salik lerum rekia, vela itchaze hasheta, ad hahu zimna deyitgele. rav metivta chama leh, vahava rashim beh leella hay kera, (Mishlei 18:10) migdal oz shem Adonai bo yarutz tzaddik venisgav. ufaris rav metivta kera da, migdal oz: da keneset yisrael.
1359: Bo yarutz tzaddik: beh reuteh detzaddik tadir. veal da, venisgav hahu migdal, dela yinpol lealmin, kema dehava.

Veribbi kerusepday chamid libba, parish hay kera ad la istallak, ufaris shappir. migdal oz: da teva, vesefer tora deihu oz, leshavvaa beh, uleappaka leh miggo hechol, diyyukena dehechol penimaa, deminneh nafka tora, vehahu migdal shem Adonai ihu, udeyyukena dileh veitzterich beshit dargin.

Bo yarutz tzaddik, beman. bemigdal, o besefer tora. ella kera darish behay uvehay. kad darash bemigdal, itzterich tzaddik da delihevi chazan hakkeneset, zakkaa dikshot, udeyyukena detzaddik illaa. kad darish lesefer tora, man desalik lesefer tora lemikre orayyta, itzterich tzaddik. vetzaddik ikre. man ikre tzaddik mekullehu. shetitaa, desalik meinnun shiva. amar ribbi shimon, vadday, deihu la salik kol yomoy, ella shetitaa leinnun desallekin. bo yarutz tzaddik, besefer tora yarutz divre tzaddik da. venisgav mimman. middechilu demalach hammavt, deha orich yomin. venisgav dela yitnezak lealmin.

Behahu migdal desalleka ben innun migdalin, kayyeyma nehiru chad, bediyyukena desefer tora, kad ate hahu tzippara, natla hahu migdal meatreh, vekaim go emtzaita daazara, go gadpe dichruvim hava. (sefer acher uma dehava). rumeh lerum shemayya maich veal techot innun keruvim, veshuroy ben reshe keruvim.
Telat mea pitchin tamman, befitcha deemtzaita, kayyeyma nehira da, diyyukena desefer tora, beh zammin melech yisrael lemikre befarashat hakehel. veda lihevi malka meshicha, vela achara.

Uvehahu sefer tora dehahu nehiru, i chasida kaddisha, zakkaa ihu demippumeh yishmeu, kal neimu demiloy meinnun millin setimin defarish beorayyta. bechol resh yarche, veshabbatte umoadayyay vezimnayyay, kad baan kol bene metivte lesalleka leella lego metivta dirkia, kullehu mitkannefe legabbe malka meshicha, veihu parish millin, umiggo metiku demiloy betiuveta, sallekin. kullehu eser millin, genizin lach meinnun millin deihu parish, leyoma disheltin dilach.

Kad kayyeyma hahu migdal beemtzau daazara, ufitcha da patach, patchin innun keruvin pumayyhu, ufarse gadpayyhu, venahir nehiru illaa al hahu pitcha. vehahu sefer tora patiach, veinnun keruvim patche veamre (Tehillim 31:20) ma rav tuvecha asher tzafanta lireecha vegomer. sagiru pitchin, vesefer tora itgelil.

Man chama, nehiru denahara dehahu sefer tora, kuleh nehora denahir, atvavn dileh, shalhove deeshsha med gavvne, deinnun dealma illaa, kullehu balte umenatztze, let man deyachil lemekam behu, bar mashiach.
Sagir pitcha da, keruvim mishtachche. vehahu migdal parach, vekayyeyma beatreh ben shear migdalin.

Behahu pitcha deemtzaita, it atara defaz illaa veyakkira geniza, dela itchaze hasheta, gelifa umechukkaka bechol zine avne yekar, uzemina lemehevi al resha demalka meshicha, kad salik behahu migdal, uteren nesharin, da missitra da, veda missitra da, natle leh bidayyhu.

Kad salik malka meshicha, mittaknin nesharin, venatle atara da, beshaata deyishre lemikre, yitpetach pitcha achara, umittamman tippuk hahi yona, deshadar noach bime tofana, dichtiv, (Bereshit 8:8) vayshallach et hayyona, hayyona: hahi deishtemoda, vela mallilu bah kadmae, vela yadu ma hi, ella mehacha nafkat, veavdat shelichuta.

Uveshaata dichtiv vela yasfa shuv elav od, la yada bar nash lean azlat, vehi tavat leatrah, veitgenizat befitcha da veihi tittol atara befumaha, uteshavi al resheh demalka meshicha, mate vela mate, ucheden ketiv, (Tehillim 21:4) tashit lerosho ateret paz.

Vechevan deyikre malka meshicha besefer tora. yekumun teren nesharin, da mikkan veda mikkan, veyona maich, umalka meshicha nachit, veitra al resheh, ad darga batraa. uteren nesharin parchin leella al resheh, veyona tavat
